2021-s-0257.summary: Eight months after China recorded its first death, more than one million people had lost their lives to Covid-19, a disease that has touched every continent and shows no signs of abating. In an effort to convey how the virus spread across the globe and triggered waves of devastating deaths in different regions, we used a ‘stream graph’ data visualisation. Guiding our readers on both mobile and desktop was not easy. We decided to use scrollytelling techniques to explain what was happening in each region at different times.
2021-s-0257.impact: Despite being a controversial data visualisation choice, we believe it was aptly suited to leaving a lasting and memorable impression while at the same time conveying the waves of death toll for each region as they occured at different times. It was discussed by popular data viz experts, including Alberto Cairo and Javier Zarracina. This earned us recognition in the global data viz community, placing us alongside WaPo and El Pais for one million death coverage. We were also approached to talk about this chart by Jon Schwabish of PolicyViz for a series he is launching in 2021 called “One chart at a time”.
2021-s-0257.tools: D3.js, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV
2021-s-0257.authors: Rebecca Pazos, Stephanie Adeline, Tampus Charles Singson, Tin May Linn, Xaquin G. V.
2021-s-0257.summaryJa: 中国が最初の死亡を記録してから8ヶ月後,100万人以上がCOVID-19で命を落とした.この病気はすべての大陸に感染し,減少の兆候を示していない.このウイルスがどのように世界中に広がり,さまざまな地域で破壊的な死亡波を引き起こしたかを伝えるために,私たちは <unk>ストリームグラフデータビジュアライゼーションを使用しました.モバイルとデスクトップの両方で読者を指導することは簡単ではありませんでした. 地域ごとに異なる時間帯で何が起きているのか説明するためにスロール・テックリ・テックリを使用することにしました
2021-s-0257.impactJa: 議論の余地のあるデータビジュアライゼーションの選択であるにもかかわらず,我々は,それは持続的で記憶に残る印象を残すのに適したと考えており,同時に各地域における死亡人数波を異なる時期に伝えています. アルベルト・カイロとハビエル・ザラシナを含む人気のあるデータ・ビザ専門家によって議論されました.これは,世界データ・ビザコミュニティで認識を得て, WaPoとEl Paisと共に100万人の死亡カバーを確立しました. 政策ヴィズのジョン・シュワビッシュも2021年に発売する『1つのチャートで1つのチャート』のシリーズについてこのチャートについて話し合った.

2021-s-0258.summary: In this project, it is a basic guide of tips to protect yourself and care for a covid patient in the home environment.
2021-s-0258.impact: This project was published in the newspaper's breaking news, as well as on all its social media channels during the confinement period.
2021-s-0258.tools: Animation, 3D modelling, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, CSV, Anime.js
2021-s-0258.summaryJa: <pre> このプロジェクトでは,自宅環境で自分自身を保護し,COVID患者へのケアするための基本的なヒントのガイドです.
2021-s-0258.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,封鎖期間中に新聞の最新ニュースやソーシャルメディアのチャンネルに掲載されました.

2021-s-0259.summary: This long-form piece explored how, through data, we can try to think about the future when everything seems so uncertain and how to explore why we're so bad at predicting the future. The project also included a tarot reading to show what tools we, as individuals, can use to better think about the future.
2021-s-0259.impact: The impact of our project was to connect to the data journalism community and show readers how lifestyle-led pieces can still be data-driven and relatable, whatever your level.
2021-s-0259.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2021-s-0259.summaryJa: この長編の作品ではデータの利用によりすべてが不確実に見えたときに未来について考えることを試みる方法やなぜ未来を予測できないのかについて探討しましたこのプロジェクトにはタロット読書も含まれました
2021-s-0259.impactJa: 私たちのプロジェクトの目的はデータジャーナリズムコミュニティと繋がりライフスタイルをベースにした作品がどんなレベルでもデータの元で関連付けられるか読者に示すことでした

2021-s-0260.summary: Flattening the curve became probably the most influential and most important chart of 2020. At the beginning of the pandemic, everyone was using that term, but we at Público felt that people didn’t understand why it was so important. That’s why we developed this scrollytelling article where people could understand a little better what that meant and what the data across the world showed us about it.
2021-s-0260.impact: This story went viral on social media. Portugal had registered the first cases at the beginning of March and numbers were increasing in April. So the timing of this story - that using scrollytelling techniques explained the little we knew about Covid-19 and added contextual data about how the situation was going on in other countries. That helped people understand better what ‘flattening the curve” meant and what was going on in other places - like Italy and South Korea.
2021-s-0260.tools: Animation, Scraping, Json, CSV, R, RStudio
2021-s-0260.summaryJa: 曲線を平坦化することは 2020年の最も影響力のある,最も重要なチャートとなった. 流行の初めは,誰もがこの用語を使用していましたが, Públicoでは,なぜそれがそんなに重要なのかを理解していないと感じました. だからこそ,人々がその意味と世界全体のデータから得られたことを理解できるようなこのスロール・テイル記事を開発しました.
2021-s-0260.impactJa: この話はソーシャルメディアで広まりました.ポルトガルは3月初旬に最初の症例を記録し,4月に数字が増加していました.この物語のタイミングは,スロールテッリング技術を使用して,COVID-19について知られることはほとんどなく,他の国で状況がどのように進行しているのかについての文脈データを追加した.それは人々が曲線を平坦化する意味と他の場所で起こっていることをよりよく理解するのに役立ちます. イタリアや韓国など.

2021-s-0261.summary: Le Monde had access to the flight data of some 800 aircraft transiting 50 of France's main business airports and some 15 foreign equivalents between the start of the French lockdown on March 17 and the end of travel restrictions on June 1. Among those flights, we found out that several CEOs used their private jet to reach their resorts and thus not respecting the law.
2021-s-0261.impact: The autorities said they will do extra-checks on the travel reasons, after people were angry finding out the travel restrictions were not applied to CEOs. Most of the top CEOs we named have asked not to be tracked anymore by the websites like FlightRadar, etc. (which we weren't using).
2021-s-0261.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Python
2021-s-0261.authors: Laura Motet (Le Monde), Emmanuel Freudenthal (freelancer working from Nairobi)
2021-s-0261.summaryJa: フランスの主要ビジネス空港50機と15機のフライトデータにアクセスできたのは 3月17日にフランスでの封鎖が始まって 6月1日に旅行制限が終了した間ですそのフライトの中で,私たちはいくつかのCEOがプライベートジェット機を利用してリゾートに到達したことを発見しました.
2021-s-0261.impactJa: 旅行の理由については,当局が追加チェックを行うと告げた. 旅行制限がCEOに適用されていないことを知った人々は怒った後. 私たちが挙げたトップCEOの多くは,FlightRadarなどのウェブサイトで追跡されないように要求した (我々が使用していなかった).

2021-s-0262.summary: In the past 20 years, housing price has continued to rise in Taiwan and it has become a serious problem. With this project, we hope to use open date from the Actual Price Registration System and family income information from the Ministry of Interior to show our readers the current housing situation. We use scrollytelling to help readers to better understand the housing price of towns and cities in Taiwan, providing simulator at the end of the article for readers to calculate their affordability.
2021-s-0262.impact: We received plenty of positive feedback from readers. They are impressed by the innovative data visualization with spike map in this project.This method brings excellent reading experience a and makes it easy to understand the data. This project also aroused some voices on social media to advocate the government to implement a policy to curb housing prices.
2021-s-0262.summaryJa: 過去20年,台湾では住宅価格が上昇し続け,深刻な問題となっています.このプロジェクトでは,実際の価格登録システムからのオープン日期と内務省の家庭収入情報を利用して,現在の住宅状況を示すことを期待しています. 台湾の町や街の住宅価格をよりよく理解するためにスロール・テイルを活用し記事末にシミュレーターを提供して読者が価格を計算できます
2021-s-0262.impactJa: このプロジェクトでは,データ可視化が革新的で,スパイクマップで実現されていることが印象的だ.この方法は,読書の優れた経験をもたらし,データを理解しやすくする.このプロジェクトは,政府に対し住宅価格を抑制する政策を実施するよう支援するために,ソーシャルメディアでいくつかの声を起こしました.

2021-s-0263.summary: Using data published by Taiwan government, we present the salary data of all listed companies with barcode diagram and use scrollytelling method to show salary distribution of each industry.
2021-s-0263.impact: The information that the government published was always the “mean”, which may easily be affected by the extreme value. Compared to the mean, the “median”, which was published for the first time, can be closer to the reality. ​
2021-s-0263.summaryJa: 台湾政府によって公表されたデータを活用して,我々はすべての上場企業の賃金のデータをバーコード図で提示し,各産業の賃金の分布を示すためにスロールテリング方法を使用します.
2021-s-0263.impactJa: 政府が公表した情報は常に <unk>平均<unk>であり,極端な値によって容易に影響を受けることがあります.平均と比べると,初めて公表された <unk>平均<unk>は現実に近いかもしれません.

2021-s-0264.summary: The report shows a hidden truth in the mining industry in Peru, which bases its operations on the labor of workers subcontracted through outsourcing companies. In the last 15 years, more than 60% of workers who died in work accidents were subcontracted. The data analysis shows that the most important mining companies are in charge of the mines that concentrate the majority of worker deaths and are also the companies that violate labor safety regulations. In addition, after analyzing databases of the Prosecutor's Office, we found that the investigations into these deaths are archived without finding those responsibles.
2021-s-0264.impact: The report was highlighted by the Federation of Mining Workers of Peru and by the Federation of Mining Contractor Workers–—organizations that have taken our report findings to demand from government authorities and mining companies better safety-health and working conditions. This took place during the mining strike carried out in December 2020. When confronted with the findings of this publication two government officials from the Ministry of Labour and the Ministry of Energy and Mines stated that outsourcing companies should operate within the framework of the law. Authorities also indicated that formal complaints are processed not only by the corresponding government departments but also by other entities that work in coordination with regional and local authorities. In an interview on the local radio station RPP, Presidential candidate and former congresswoman, Verónika Mendoza also criticized that large mining companies have their workers in precarious situations that put their lives at risk, for which she proposed a new regime that "stops the abuse of outsourcing." Even though mining is an economic activity that moves millions of dollars, the majority of workers are still subcontracted through outsourcing companies—companies that ignore the precarious working conditions workers endure. It’s also important to highlight that the mining industry exercises great control on the political arena and perhaps it’s one of the sectors that has the most lobbyists in Peru. Because authorities argued that mining was imperative for the economic development of the country, mining companies in our country never stopped operating during the pandemic even though the lives of hundreds of workers were at risk. This investigation has exposed for the first time an issue that the media has never covered.
2021-s-0264.authors: Luis Enrique Pérez Pinto and Milagros Salazar Herrera
2021-s-0264.summaryJa: 報告書はペルーの鉱業業界に隠された真実を示しています.この会社は外包会社を通じてサブコントラストされた労働者の労働をベースに運営しています.過去15年間で,労働事故で死亡した労働者の60%以上がサブコントラストされた.データ分析によると,最も重要な鉱業企業は,労働者の死亡の大半を集めている鉱山を担当しており,労働安全規制を違反している企業でもある. さらに検察のデータベースを分析した結果これらの死事件の調査は記録されているが責任者は見つからないことがわかりました
2021-s-0264.impactJa: 報告書はペルー鉱業労働組合と鉱業契約労働組合の連盟によって強調され,この報告の成果を政府当局や鉱業企業から安全・健康と労働条件を向上させるよう要求した.これは2020年12月に実施された鉱業ストライキ中に行われた. この出版物の結論に直面した際には,労働省とエネルギー鉱山省の2人の政府関係者は,外包企業が法律の枠組み内で活動すべきだと述べました.当局はまた,公式の苦情は,政府部門だけでなく,地域および地方自治体との連携で働く他の機関によって処理されていることを指摘しました. 地方ラジオ局RPPのインタビューで,大統領候補兼元議員のベロンリカ・メンデザは,大規模な鉱山企業が彼らの労働者を危険にさらす不確実な状況に置いていると批判し,そのために"アウトソーシングの悪用を止める"新しい体制を提案した. 鉱業は政治領域を大きくコントロールし,おそらくペルーで最もロビー活動家が多い分野の一つである.当局が国の経済発展に鉱業が不可欠だと主張したため,私たちの国の鉱業会社は,何百人もの労働者の命が危険にさらされているにもかかわらず,パンデミック期間中に活動を止めることはありませんでした. この調査で初めてメディアが報道していない問題が明らかになりました

2021-s-0265.summary: Six months after the Philippines imposed a lockdown in Metro Manila and Luzon, we assessed how the Philippines is performing so far in its fight against COVID-19. Among others, we found out that Metro Manila remained the country's pandemic "epicenter" at the time. The country's positivity rate also hovered above the WHO benchmark. Hospitals got a breather after stricter quarantines were temporarily implemented in some hot spots, but critical care levels are still far from reassuring. We also pointed out issues with the dataset from the Philippines' health department.
2021-s-0265.impact: The story showed readers the situation in the country 6 months into a lockdown that was meant to lessen the spread of COVID-19. Experts also weighed in on what issues in government responses and cases data itself still persist, and what more needs to be done to plug the gaps.
2021-s-0265.authors: Michael Bueza, Rianna Cruz, Christine Okubo
2021-s-0265.summaryJa: フィリピンがメトロ・マニラとルゾンに封鎖を課した6ヶ月後,我々は,COVID-19との戦いにおいてフィリピンがこれまでの成績を評価した.他にも,我々はメトロ・マニラが当時,この国の流行の"エピセントラル"であり続けたことを発見した.この国の陽性率はWHO基準値を超えていました. 病院は一時的に厳しい隔離措置が導入された後呼吸を回復しましたが危急治療のレベルはまだ安心感を与えないままですまた,フィリピン保健省のデータセットの問題点も指摘しました.
2021-s-0265.impactJa: この記事では,COVID-19の感染拡大を軽減するために6ヶ月間かけて行われた封鎖の状況が読者に示されました. また,専門家たちは,政府の対応や症例データにおける問題や,ギャップを埋めるために,何がもっとすべきかについても検討しました.

2021-s-0266.summary: Days after the Indian Government passed the new land laws in jammu Kashmir and transferred many thousand acres of Forest land to the Industries and Commerce Department, the administration started demolishing the settlements in the Forest areas of the Himalayan region. The Indigenous Gujjar Bakerwal community of Jammu Kashmir has been living in forests for eternity and has been taking care of forests. Since members of the Gujjar Bakerwal community did not have access to education in the beginning, they settled themselves in forests and start living on their own by growing their crops and creating temporary shelters.
2021-s-0266.impact: The story came out a time when Journalism in Kashmir has been virtually put under a crackdown, anything that contradicts the official narrative, is punished with jails, harrasment, physical or verbal abuse. The project was undertaken and later the story published at such a time when everyone celebrated the 'illegal settlers' being removed,Senior politicians from the valley visited the areas to demand the rights of Forest dwellers. As the story was going viral, not more than 48 hours the local administration which has after 05 of August 2019, when the special status of Jammu Kashmir was abrogated, implemented all the Central laws and was reluctant to not implement the Forest Rights Act-2006 (A central law which gives land possession rights to indigenous Forest dwellers) was ordered to be implemented in the region.
2021-s-0266.authors: Qazi Shibli, Mir Musavir, Atta ul Mumin Zahid, Muzamil Bashir
2021-s-0266.summaryJa: インド政府はジャム・カシミールで新しい土地法を通過し,何千エーカーの森林地を産業商取引局に譲った数日後,行政はヒマラヤ地域の森林地帯の住居地を破壊し始めた.ジャム・カシミールの原住民グジャール・ベーカーウォールコミュニティは,永遠に森に住んでいて,森林を世話してきた. ガージャー・ベイカーウォールコミュニティのメンバーは当初教育を受けることができなかったため,彼らは森に定住し,農作物を栽培し,一時的な避難所を作ることで自力で暮らし始めました.
2021-s-0266.impactJa: この物語は,カシミールにおけるジャーナリズムが事実上抑圧され,公式の物語に反するものは,刑務所,嫌がらせ,身体的または言語的虐待で罰される時代に登場した.このプロジェクトは開始され,後にこの物語は,すべての人が"不法入植者"の移除を祝うときに公開された. この話が広まっていたため,地方行政は, 2019年8月5日以降,ジャム・カシミールの特別地位が廃止された時,すべての中央法を施行し,2006年の森林権利法 (原住民の土地所有権を与える中央法) を施行しないことを躊躇したので, 48時間以上以内に,この地域で実施するよう命令されました.

2021-s-0267.summary: India and China have been locked in a border dispute since April 2020 when rival soldiers were engaged in skirmishes at several points on their mountain border. Home to the world’s two most populated countries, with a combined population of nearly three billion, the interactive mapping story visually helps readers understand the situation on the ground and what is at stake.
2021-s-0267.impact: This was one of the biggest news stories in the sub-continent in 2020. The interactive map, 3d models and mobile friendly graphics have been shared by many on social media since publishing. The story gathered hundreds of thousads of page views, mostly from India, and an average time on page of nearly 6 minutes.
2021-s-0267.summaryJa: インドと中国は2020年4月以来国境紛争に巻き込まれています. 敵対軍は山岳国境のいくつかの点で戦闘に参加しました. 世界で最も人口が多い2つの国,人口約30億の共同人口に拠点を置くこのインタラクティブな地図ストーリーは,読者に地上での状況を視覚的に理解し,何が問題になっているかを理解するのに役立ちます.
2021-s-0267.impactJa: このニュースは2020年の亜大陸最大のニュース記事の一つでした. インタラクティブな地図,3Dモデルとモバイルフレンドリーなグラフィックが公開以来,ソーシャルメディアで多くの人々が共有しています.この記事は,主にインドから数十万件のページビューを集め,平均的なページ時間はほぼ6分です.

2021-s-0268.summary: Kashmir is one of the hardest places in the world in which to be transgender. Not only does the community face discrimination but heavy restrictions imposed by the Indian military and now by the coronavirus pandemic are making life especially difficult.
2021-s-0268.impact: The video piece was largely produced and filmed for the United States audience so that the unheard voices of the transgender community from Kashmir can be told to the outer world. The project had a great impact after it was released this year - many activists started talking on the trans issues and supported them in many ways which gave hope to the community despite they face discrimination and threats from the conservative society of Kashmir.
2021-s-0268.authors: Bhat, Burhan Saqib, Mugloo Robert, Leslie
2021-s-0268.summaryJa: カシミールは世界で最も難しいトランスジェンダーである地域です. コミュニティは差別に直面するだけでなく,インド軍と現在ではコロナウイルス流行によって課された厳しい制限が生活を特に困難にしています.
2021-s-0268.impactJa: このビデオは主に米国人の観客のために制作され,撮影されたため,カシミールからのトランスジェンダーコミュニティの未聞な声を外の世界に伝えることができる.このプロジェクトは今年公開後,大きな影響を与えた.多くの活動家たちがトランスジェンダー問題について話し始め,多くの方法で支援し,彼らはカシミールで保守的な社会から差別と脅迫に直面しているにもかかわらず,コミュニティに希望を与えた.

2021-s-0269.summary: 'The UK construction companies in breach of the Modern Slavery Act' is a long-form investigation that explores how many UK construction companies do not comply with the Act, by not publishing a Modern Slavery Statement. The investigation includes the case study of one of the major hot spots of modern slavery in the construction sector: Indian brick kilns. The story also examines the poor quality of the statements that are published, and the failures of the Act to hold companies to account.
2021-s-0269.impact: In response to a Freedom of Information Request, the Home Office acknowledged that their approach to organisations identified as not having published a statement was under active review and that they were also considering potential future changes to section 54 of the Modern Slavery Act 2015. The investigation was picked up by NGOs such as Anti-Slavery International, Hope for Justice UK, Slave-Free Alliance, and Sustain Worldwide, among others.
2021-s-0269.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, Microsoft Excel, CSV, R, RStudio, Python
2021-s-0269.summaryJa: "近代奴隷制法違反した英国の建設企業"は,近代奴隷制宣言を公表しないことで,英国の建設企業が法律に遵守していない数件を調査する長い調査です.調査には,建設業界における近代奴隷制の主な熱点の一つであるインドレンガ炉のケース・スタディが含まれています. また,この記事は公表された声明の質が悪くて,法律が企業を責任に負けないことも検討しています.
2021-s-0269.impactJa: 情報の自由を求める要請に応じた内務省は,声明を公表していないと認定された組織に対する彼らのアプローチが積極的に検討されていると認め,また,現代奴隷制法2015 第54条に将来の潜在的な変更を検討していると認め,調査は,奴隷制防止国際,正義のための希望英国,奴隷自由同盟,そしてSustain WorldwideなどのNGOによって取り上げられた.

2021-s-0270.summary: It is an investigative article written by Data Critica and edited by Quinto Elemento Lab that revealed how Mexican authorities underrepresented indigenous people in the public currently 4 Between March and September of 2020, age, sex, medical conditions, if the patient speaks an indigenous language, state of residence, and other demographic data records of people registered after taking a Covid test were published, but ethnicity records were removed, effectively making impossible to know the impact of the pandemics on this populations for most of the pandemics. Even after releasing data, statistical estimations from census data show the numbers are grossly
2021-s-0270.impact: "It is true: even in death we are invisible", told me after the piece was published a 23 Mayan teacher in southeast Yucatán. He participated then in the writing of a manifesto, gathering with other indigenous activists. They have not finished it but hard data evidence of structural racism is often needed by this kind of organizations. The piece, written by me for Data Critica and edited by Quinto Elemento Lab, was selected as part of the best of Data Journalism by the Global Investigative Journalism Network in January. During that month in Mexico it was taken by national broadcasters W Radio, the Mexican Institute for the Radio, Radio Educación an in national television by La Octava. It was also later on published by NBC Universal spanish arm Telemundo and the spanish outlet ElDiario.es, in addition to the 8 mexican investigative and independent news outlets that originally published in Mexico.
2021-s-0270.tools: Scraping, QGIS, Json, CSV, R, RStudio

2021-s-0270.impactJa: "それは本当です.死でも私たちは見えません"とユカタン南東部にある23人のマヤ教員が論文が出版された後,私に語った.彼は当時宣言の執筆に参加し,他の原住民活動家たちと集まった.彼らはそれを完成していないが,構造的な人種差別の証拠を固としたデータで示すことは,しばしばこのような組織に必要である. 論文は,私がデータ・クリティカに書いたもので,クイント・エレメント・ラボが編集したもので,グローバル・インテリゲटिवジャーナリズム・ネットワークが1月に"データ・ジャーナリズム"のベスト作品として選出しました.その月,メキシコでは,全国放送局Wラジオ,メキシコラジオ研究所,ラジオ教育とテレビ局La Octavaによって撮影されました. その後,NBCユニバーサルスペイン支部テレモンドとスペインのエルディアリオ.エス社によって,メキシコで最初に出版された8つのメキシコの調査および独立したニュース機関に加えて,出版されました.

2021-s-0271.summary: HEART DESEASES- This is the primary cause of death in Palawan, base on study, this is brought by the food we eat that contains Trans Fatty Acids ( SAKIT SA PUSO - ito ang Isa sa mga pangunahing ikinakamatay ng mga taga-Palawan. Batay sa mga pag aaral, ito ay dulot nga mga pagkaing nagtataglay ng TRANS FATTY ACIDS. Alamin ang panganib dulot ng TRANS FAT sa ating kalusugan, at ano ang magagawa ng ating lokal na pamahalaan tungkol dito. Panoorin ang special na dokyu na ito - produksyon ng Palawan Daily News katuwang ang Probe Media Foundation, Inc. at Imagine
2021-s-0271.impact: One thing this pandemic taught us, is to be aware of the kinds of food we eat, many became health conscious and change their diet. One of that is avoiding food that contains Trans Fatty Acids (TFA), this is usually found in the food that undergoes process like cooking or frying it with oil that came from animals. Palawan being known as world’s best island is no exemption with that, but this treat of Trans Fat is somewhat new to many Palawenos, majority are unaware of the danger that food contains TFA may bring to their health. According to the data from Palawan Provincial Health Office, Cardio Vascular Diseases (CVD) is rank 3 in the causes of mortality with 139 cases for the year 2018, while its capital the City Puerto Princesa listed Acute Myocardial Infarction as the leading cause of mortality for the year 2019 with 183 cases, and hypertension is on the fifth slot with 92 cases. The said diseases mostly connect with heart problems, as per study it can be resulted by consuming Trans Fat in our food, the World Health Organization also reported that there are 540,000 people worldwide annually die of CVD.

2021-s-0271.impactJa: この流行が教えてくれたのは,私たちが食べている食べ物について意識し,健康意識を持ち,食事を変えることでした. その一つは,トランス脂肪酸 (TFA) を含んでいる食品を避けることです.これは通常,動物から生じた油で調理したり,焼いたりするようなプロセスに伴う食品です. パラワン島は世界最高の島として知られているが,このトランス脂肪の特化法はパラウェノ人の多くにとって新しいもので,ほとんどのパラウェノ人は TFAを含む食品が健康に及ぼす危険を認識していない. パラワン省保健局のデータによると,心臓血管疾患 (CVD) は2018年の死亡原因で3位に並び,2018年の死亡原因は139件で,首都プエルトプリンセサ市は183件で急性心筋梗塞を2019年の死亡原因として挙げ,高血圧は92件で第5位に並びました. これらの病気は主に心臓病に関連しており,研究によると,私たちの食生活の中でトランス脂肪を摂取することで引き起こされる可能性がある. 世界保健機関はまた,世界中で毎年,54万人以上がCVDで死亡すると報告しています.

2021-s-0272.summary: The government of Pakistan claims that a majority of the complaints shared by citizens through an official smartphone app were resolved but data and the accounts narrated by app users reveal that the government departments are falsely closing complaints without actually resolving the issues raised by the citizens. This project reveals how the government is drumming up the numbers and ignoring the reports of dis-satisfaction from citizens.
2021-s-0272.impact: The reporting and publication of this project forced the government to reveal statistics about unsatisfactory ratings by citizens who use the official smartphone app. This metric is important in understanding the effectiveness of the public grievance system.
2021-s-0272.summaryJa: パキスタン政府は,公式スマートフォンアプリを通じて市民が共有した苦情の大半が解決されたと主張しているが,データとアプリユーザーの説明によるアカウントは,政府部門が市民が提起した問題を実際に解決せずに,苦情を偽りの形で閉鎖していることを示している.このプロジェクトは,政府が数字をどのように鼓舞し,市民の不満の報告を無視しているかを明らかにしている.
2021-s-0272.impactJa: このプロジェクトの報告と公表により,政府は公式スマートフォンアプリを使用する市民による不満足な評価に関する統計を明らかにするよう強制された.この指標は,公的苦情制度の有効性を理解するために重要です.

2021-s-0273.summary: Every time was an election, supporters from different camps always yelled at each other. What are the differences or similarities between these people? Since November 2019, we have participated in a total of 21 gatherings of the two presidential candidates. We interviewed over 1000 supporters of both candidates with the designed format and tried to understand the value of the passionate supporters of the two sides.
2021-s-0273.impact: During elections, media often turned the two factions into rivals with different values. READr tried to use data to understand the appearance of these people, found out similarities and differences, and promote dialogue and understanding. We focused on the issues of economy, democracy, the relationship with China, and self-identification. Another topic was "value priority". We tried to understand the supporters' priority choices among the six values of "economic development", "order", "law-abiding", "democracy", "freedom" and "equality". We found that these supporters who were willing to be interviewd have almost the same central ideas as the candidates on stage. The values of the two supporters are very different. The few consensuses reached on all topic are "democratic values" and "Taiwan should cooperate more closely with the world." We even found traces of the rise of populism.
2021-s-0273.authors: Lee Yu Ju, Liu Tzu-Wei, Chen Pei yu, Li Chao Yen, Chen Yi-Chian, Chien Hsin-chan
2021-s-0273.summaryJa: 選挙の各回,各キャンプの支持者は常に互いに叫びました.この人達の違いは何ですか? 2019年11月以来,私たちは大統領候補者2人の総集約21回の集会に参加しました.我々は設計された形式で両候補者の1000人以上の支持者をインタビューし,両党の熱狂的な支持者の価値を理解しようとしました.
2021-s-0273.impactJa: 選挙の際にメディアはしばしば両派を異なる価値観を持つライバルに変えた. READrは,これらの人々の外見を理解するためにデータを利用し,類似点と違いを発見し,対話と理解を促進しようと試みた.我々は経済,民主主義,中国との関係,自己認識に関する問題に焦点を当てました.もう一つのテーマは"価値優先事項"でした. "経済発展"",秩序"",法守"",民主主義"",自由"及び"平等"という6つの価値観の中で支持者の優先順位を選択することを理解しようと試みました.インタビューを受けたいと願った支持者達は,ステージ上の候補者と同じ中心的な考えを持っていることがわかりました.両支持者の価値観は非常に異なる. "民主主義の価値観"と"台湾は世界と緊密に協力すべきだ"という意見の共識が全てに達されました

2021-s-0274.summary: Due to a unique data-related complexity, Israeli election results have never been mapped accurately beyond municipality-level. Data analysts have produced approximations and journalists have explored specific neighborhood-level stories, but only a combination of journalistic research into the election mechanisms and a painstaking analysis of the datasets - partly inaccessible to the publich - enabled the creation of a detailed, granular, and accurate results map. This project entails both the map, which was updated live as results were released, and a map-based story that introduced these results to international readers.
2021-s-0274.impact: The main impact of the project was the proof that such an analysis is possible. Journalists have used the map for their reporting or reported on the map. In the long run, this project will hopefully set a new standard for election mapping in the Israeli media, where this practice is still immature. More importantly, repeating it in three election rounds in 2018-2019, during which the authorities recieved the same inquiries over and over again, could lead to the understanding that the necessary datasets should be released to the public.
2021-s-0274.summaryJa: 選挙結果は,自治体レベルを超えて正確に地図化されることはなかった.データ分析者は近似を制作し,ジャーナリストは地域レベルでの特定の物語を調査した.しかし,選挙メカニズムに関するジャーナリズムの研究とデータセットの徹底的な分析の組み合わせと,部分的に公衆にとってアクセスできないデータセットのみが詳細で細かい,詳細で正確な結果地図を作成することが可能になった. このプロジェクトには成果が公開された時直接更新された地図と成果を国際読者に紹介した地図ベースのストーリーの両方が含まれています
2021-s-0274.impactJa: プロジェクトの主な影響は,このような分析が可能であることを証明した.ジャーナリストは,地図を使って報告した.長期的には,このプロジェクトは,この慣習がまだ未熟であるイスラエルメディアにおける選挙マッピングの新たな基準を設定することを期待する. さらに重要なことは,当局が繰り返し同じ問い合わせを受けた2018-2019年の3回の選挙で再確認すれば,必要なデータセットが公開されるべきという理解につながることがある.

2021-s-0275.summary: Culture is not the most common topic in data journalism. We wanted to see how the role and share of women in Finnish film industry has changed during the years. Hypothesis was that 2010´s was the decade when women truly had a big role in making movies. We didn’t look at actors but concentrated on directors, producers, writers, camera(wo)men etc. The data was from years 1913-2020.
2021-s-0275.impact: The main impact was that the story showed how in Finland women have never made as many movies as today. Our data also had ratings of the movies so we could show that nowadays movies directed by women get more viewers on average than those directed by men. This is a historical change.
2021-s-0275.authors: Eveliina Mäntylä, Antti J. Hämäläinen, Jukka Himanen, JP Laitinen, Lilli Korhonen, Olli Nurminen, Aino Miikkulainen, Juho Salminen
2021-s-0275.summaryJa: 文化はデータジャーナリズムにおける最も一般的な話題ではありません. 我々は,フィンランドの映画業界における女性の役割とシェアが何年にもわたってどのように変化したかを見たいと考えました. 仮説は,2010年は女性たちが映画制作において本当に大きな役割を果たした10年だったという. 私たちは俳優を観察せず,監督,プロデューサー,作家,カメラの制作,そしてそれ等に集中した.
2021-s-0275.impactJa: 女性の映画監督は,男性より平均的に視聴者が多いことを示すために,我々のデータも映画評価を記録しました.これは歴史的な変化です.

2021-s-0276.summary: The project relied on collating primary data on online abuses directed at journalists and rights activists in Ghana. The report highlights the top ten most abused journalists in Ghana, the forms of abuse, gender distribution and patforms where the abuse happens.
2021-s-0276.impact: A petition was submitted to the Ghana Police Service based on the primary data of abuses collected as part of this report. The police has promised to carry out the necesary investigations on the abuses and harassments that bothers on criminality. A guideline for prevention of online abuse was developed by iWatch Africa in cordination with the Commission on Human Rights Abuse and Administrative Justice in Ghana as a report of the report. The report brought up the issue of online violence to the top of the agenda in Ghana with over 5000 mentions on Twitter and radio and TV discussions. iWatch Africa team was invited to speak about our report during the Forum on Internet Freedom in Africa 2020 (#FIFAfrica20) organised by CIPESA and Paradign Inititaive. Journalists now are able to reach us directly when abused and we have also set up a team that tracks and reports online abuses in real time.
2021-s-0276.authors: Gideon Sarpong, Moro Seidu, Henry Kyeremeh and 10 members of our online abuse tracking team.
2021-s-0276.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,ガーナにおけるジャーナリストや人権活動家に対するオンライン虐待に関する主要なデータを収集した.このレポートではガーナで最も虐待されたジャーナリストのトップ10位,虐待の形態,ジェンダー分布,虐待が起こる場所のパットフォームを強調した.
2021-s-0276.impactJa: この報告書の一環として収集された虐待の基本データに基づいて,ガーナ警察局に請願書が提出されました.警察は犯罪を悩ます虐待や嫌がらせに関する必要な調査を実施すると約束しました.報告書の報告書として,iWatchアフリカがガーナの人権侵害と行政司法に関する委員会と連携してオンライン虐待防止ガイドラインを開発しました. このレポートでは,Twitterやラジオやテレビで5000件以上の言及が寄せられ,オンライン暴力の問題をガーナで議題に挙げました. iWatchアフリカチームは,CIPESAとパラダイムイニシアチブが主催するアフリカにおけるインターネット自由フォーラム2020 (#FIFAfrica20) の際に,我々のレポートについて話すよう招待されました.ジャーナリストは,虐待されたときに直接連絡することができます.また,オンライン上の虐待をリアルタイムで追跡し報告するチームも設立しました.

2021-s-0277.summary: The story was firdt published in A former high ranking government official is implicated in a corruption saga worth millions. The man is accussed of using his power and status to benefit directly from lower structures he was overseeing without openly declaring his interests. Millions have gone missing and there is no guaranteee they will ever be recovered. Meanwhile the former boss has his finger prints all over the crime scene and the matter has been reported to the Directorate on Corruption and Economic Crime, Botswana. Paragraph 7 words in italics.Direct quote translation. "Let us not be jealous of the
2021-s-0277.impact: The story opened eyes to those in power that there are consquences to abuse of power when in office.It also served as a warning to many others occupying high positions that irregardles of who you are, there is no excuse to corruption as it negatively impacts on country development. Most importantly, the project served as a reminder of what corruption in office does to the community. Projects remain stagnant and poverty escalates while money is gobbled up by those trusted with power to change lives for the better. The story has assisted other government officials to keep an open mind and device ways of ensuring that financial issues are handled with utmost care and transparency where possible. Loop holes at the particular organization have been identified that enable issues of corruption to easily crop in. This has led to the current boss at the organization admitting that there is need for policies to change in the near future to curb as it had now proven that there might be a deeper financial rot lying undetected. Also the public has been sentisized on the worrying and increaing corruption issues that happen even at government level. This means stakeholders will in future hold officers accountable and demand transparency when it comes to governmemt funds. The relevant ministry will equally in future do a better job of detecting issues of funds embezzlement at the earliest time possible. The story has also through interviews conducted helped the law officers speed up their investigations on the matter as the story unearthed information which was not readily in their possession.

2021-s-0278.summary: The story of a young female politician who is trying to make it in the dog eat dog political space. She is bashed on a regular basis for her approach to issues of empowering women. She one of those fighting for women to be recognized, she advocates for women to be heard and even see them occupy leadership positions even at parliament level. She has been labelled a feminist, an empty vessel and a whore, Acussed of sleeping her way to the top but she remains rooted to politics. She once spent a night in a holding cell but still
2021-s-0278.impact: The story was trying to reach out to women and even men to create an environment where women can freely join politics, a field that has for the longest periods been associated with men. Kgosidintsi's political ambitions are testimony that women are capable of joining politics, Despite the harsh environment, there is need for women to be represented at both parliament and cabinet level to enable them be part of decision making processes. During the 2019 general elections, only three women were elected to parliament, this was not a case of them losing but because only a few had contested for the elections. Despite winning and making it to parliament, female politicians are constantly bashed and ridiculed, they even cry abuse on several occassions. This is casting fear that more women will continue to shun politics, labelling it brutal and a man;s world. Kgosidintsi's story is meant to encourage other women to fight for what they believe in and not be intimidated by obstacles encountered. Her story is also meant to inform those in power what it is they need to do better to help women rise. This comes at a time that Botswana is trying hard to achieve gender equality and do away with issues of denying women equal access to jobs, sexual violence and exploitation. Traditionally, a girl child is expected to stay home and take care of the home, cook for her husband and bear children. The story spoke to Kgosidintsi's parents to learn how thry raised their child. Why she is so outspoken and not 'reserved' like women are expected to. This has also assisted other parents learn that they need to raise a confident girl child who is not afraid to speak their mind and not deemed disrespectful. not talking has resulted in women being
2021-s-0278.summaryJa: 女性の権利の確保を主張する女性です.彼女は女性を認識し,女性を聞かされ,議会レベルでも指導職に就くよう訴える.彼女はフェミニスト,空っぽの船,娼婦と称されている.彼女は上位まで寝ていると非難されていますが,政治に根付いています. 刑務所で夜を過ごしましたが
2021-s-0278.impactJa: 物語は,女性が自由に政治に参加できる環境を作り出すために,女性や男性まで接触しようとしていた.この分野は,最も長い期間男性と関連づけられている.Kgosidintsiの政治的野望は,女性が政治に参加できる能力の証である.厳しい環境にもかかわらず,女性が議会や内閣レベルで代表される必要がある. 2019年総選挙では3人の女性が議会に選出されたため,敗戦したわけではなく,選挙に参戦した数少ない女性だったためでした.勝利して議会に参戦したにもかかわらず,女性政治家たちは絶えず殴られ,嘲笑され,何度も虐待を叫びます.これは,より多くの女性が政治を避け続ける恐れを醸し出し,残酷と男性の世界とラベル付けています. 博茨ワナでは,女性を平等に雇用,性的暴力,搾取に奪われる問題や問題を取り除くために努力している. 博茨ワナでは,女性を平等に雇用,搾取に奪われる問題や問題を取り除くために,女性を平等に雇用,搾取に奪われる問題や問題を取り除くために,ボ茨ワナが努力している. 伝統的に,女の子は家にいて家事を面倒見,夫のために料理をしたり,子供を生むようにすることが期待されています.この物語は,クゴシディンツィの両親に子供を育った方法について語り,なぜ彼女は女性のように口を開いて,女性のように"予約"していないのかを知るために話しました.これは他の親にも,自分の意見を述べることを恐れず,不尊重とみなされない自信のある女の子を育てる必要があることを学ぶのに役立つ.

2021-s-0279.summary: On June 6th, 2020, voters in Kaohsiung went to the polls to determine the fate of Mayor Han Kuo-Yu, a deeply divisive politician who made a bid for Taiwan's presidency six months earlier. The recall vote marked the first special municipality mayor to be successfully recalled in Taiwan's history.
2021-s-0279.impact: This project served as a live vote results and analysis page for Mayor Han Kuo-Yu's recall vote. As the vote was being reported, this project became a highly visited and shared website for people following the vote results. In the topmost section, Commonwealth Magazine published the two conditions for recall, the most important information to our readers. Following the vote results, we included a map breaking down the votes by district, and then further compared the results with Han's electoral results from his previous elections. Because Mayor Han achieved notoriety in his bid for the presidency six months earlier, Commonwealth Magazine realized that this vote would also be of interest to a more international audience. Thus, Commonwealth Magazine was also able to reach both a domestic and international audience by publishing in both Chinese and English. In 2020 alone, Commonwealth Magazine ran four different live vote trackers, quickly establishing a name in Taiwanese media for reliable, quick, and clean elections results reporting online.
2021-s-0279.tools: D3.js, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV
2021-s-0279.authors: Rebecca Lin, Johann Tsai, Chen-Hua Chen, Andy Lin, Daniel Kao, Yu-Ting Huang, Yu-Hsin Lee
2021-s-0279.summaryJa: 2020年6月6日,高雄の選挙人は,台湾大統領選に6ヶ月前に出場した深層分裂の政治家,ハン・クオ・ユ市長の命運を決定するために投票に出ました.召集投票は台湾の歴史の中で初めて特別市長を成功に召集した.
2021-s-0279.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,市長ハン・クオ・ユの召喚投票のライブ結果と分析ページとして機能しました.投票が報告され,このプロジェクトは投票結果を追跡する人々にとって非常に訪問され,共有されたウェブサイトになりました.トップセクションでは,コンモンウェルツ誌は召喚の2つの条件を公表しました. 選挙結果の後,選挙結果を地区ごとに分割した地図を掲載し,その結果をハン氏の前の選挙結果と比較した.ハン市長が6ヶ月前に大統領選に参戦したことで知名になったため,コンモンウェルツ誌は,この投票は国際的な観客にとっても興味を惹くだろうことに気づいた. 共同体の雑誌は中国語と英語の両方で出版することで国内外の視聴者に達することができました.2020年に,共同体の雑誌は4つの異なるライブ投票追跡装置を運営し,信頼性,迅速,そしてきれいな選挙結果をオンラインで報告するために台湾メディアで名声を迅速に確立しました.

2021-s-0280.summary: Kenya Airways; Fall of the Pride, is a four-part in-depth analysis of Kenya Airways and how it moved from a promising profit-making airline in the continent to a multibillion loss-making company, highlighting mismanagement, embezzlement and corruption that has brought down the company to its knees, surviving through government bailouts. We analyzed the company’s annual reports from 1996 to 2020, used leaked audit reports that the public had never seen/heard off. The documentary is timely as there is legislation in Kenyan parliament to nationalize the airline.
2021-s-0280.impact: Some of the major corruption, mismanagement and embezzlement the documentary uncovered include; the purchase of airplanes through a Special Purpose Vehicles registered in Cayman island a popular tax haven, the directors/owners of the company are unknown as the SPV’s are owned by another company which is owned by ‘unspecified charity organization’. One of the SPV was used to purchase 10 Embraer Jets at increased cost of over 400,000 USD each, costing the airline 40 million USD. The documentary also revealed how one finance officer colluded with officers from Dubai bank to embezzle funds from Kenya Airways through repatriation of foreign currency without authorization. The officer and his wife benefited from the deals as the bank deposited a total of 22 million shillings to their personal accounts. We also revealed the unbalanced joint venture between Kenya Airways and KLM Dutch Airlines, where KLM had 2 members on the board of KQ who had veto powers in. This led to KQ buying old technology from KLM among them two planes at a cost of 2 billion shillings which KQ sold after 5 years at a combined cost of 210 million shillings.
2021-s-0280.authors: Maurice Oniang'o (Producer, Director and Writer-Team Lead), John-Allan Namu (EP & Narration), Purity Mukami (Lead Data), John Gathuna (Editor), Sam Munia and Elijah Kanyi (Camera Operations), C Muema, M Njoroge, E Wanjala and J Ndindi- (Co-Producers)
2021-s-0280.summaryJa: ケニア航空; プライドの崩壊,ケニア航空の4部の深入分析であり,大陸の有望な利益を得ている航空会社から数十億ドルもの損失を伴う会社に移行した方法です. 管理不良,不正,腐敗が企業を膝を下げ,政府救済を通じて生き残ったことを強調しています. 1996年から2020年にかけての会社の年次報告書を分析し,公衆が見たことのないリークされた監査報告書を使用しました. Kenian議会で航空会社を国民化する法律が制定されているため,ドキュメンタリーは時間的に作られています.
2021-s-0280.impactJa: 文書が明らかにした主要な腐敗,不正管理,不正不正のいくつかは; ケーマン島で登録された特殊目的車両を通じて航空機を購入会社の取締役/所有者は不明 SPV<unk>は別の会社所有であり <unk>未指定慈善団体所有です航空会社に4000万ドル以上の費用をかけて10機のエムブラエールジェットを購入するために使用された.ドキュメンタリーでは,金融担当者が,許可なく外国通貨を国へ持ち帰ることで,ケニア航空からの資金を不正に賄うために,ドバイ銀行の役人と協調したことも明らかにした. またケニア航空とKLMオランダ航空との間にある失衡の共同事業を明らかにしました KLMはKQの取締役会に2人の議長が拒否権を有していましたこれはKQがKLMから古い技術を購入し 2億ドルで2機を購入し 5年後には2億000万ドルで販売しました

2021-s-0281.summary: The project was an analysis and investigation of how Kenyan doctors are being affected by the Covid-19 pandemic. Many are dying and some are working while positive. They have also not been cushioned from the virus despite there existing scandals around PPEs where billions of money were embezzled. The doctors threatened to proceed on strike which they eventually did on Monday, December 21, 2020.
2021-s-0281.impact: The project highlighted the plight of Kenyan doctors in Kenya to the whole world. It also informed donors of how funds were being embezzled by cartels in the Health Ministry. Doctors also grabbed the external global pressure to champion for their rights.
2021-s-0281.summaryJa: プロジェクトではケニアの医師がCOVID-19の流行の影響を受けている様子を分析し調査した.多くの医師が死亡し,何人かは陽性で働いています.また,数十億ドルもの資金が不正に賄われたPPEのスキャンダルがあったにもかかわらず,彼らはウイルスの影響から緩和されていません.医師は2020年12月21日 (月) にストライキを開始すると脅した.
2021-s-0281.impactJa: プロジェクトではケニアの医師の苦悩を全世界に強調し,医療省のカルテルの資金不正について寄付者に知らせました.医師は,外部の世界的な圧力を受け,権利擁護を求めた.

2021-s-0282.summary: In late 2019, reporters at the Investigative Center of Ján Kuciak and Investigace.cz obtained the complete police case file on the 2018 murders of investigative reporter Jan Kuciak and his fiance Martina Kusnirova. A total of 53 TB of material, the archive included materials that implicated businessman Marian Kocner and officials in corrupt activities. OCCRP’s data and tech teams spent 4 months wrangling the massive amount of information and setting up “Kocner’s Library,” a secure leak room in Bratislava with viewing stations where journalists could explore the material and then “check out” specific files for offline study.
2021-s-0282.impact: The journalists created and coordinated a team of about 20 top Slovak journalists from trustworthy Slovak media. The team was designed to reach to wide audience and cover all possible needs of a good investigative team - there were analysts from dailies, TV stations and even journalists from tabloid. The unusual arrangement of Kocner’s Library gave a team of journalists in Slovakia free access to the information from the leak to follow and investigate leads that hold power to account. Equally important was securing the police file during the trial of Marian Kocner to ensure a free and fair judicial process. Reporters showed how Kocner secured influence with threats, bribery, and blackmail of public officials, sometimes by recording audio and video of meetings with them. During multiple raids in 2020, Slovak police arrested 20 judges, including judges from the supreme court, who allegedly took bribes for ruling in favor of Kočner´s interest or leaked sensitive information to him. . Apart from the 20 judges, one constitutional judge resigned because of his ties to Marian Kocner, one bankruptcy trustee, three lawyers and four other people were arrested. Slovakia’s police chief and the head of its financial crimes unit both resigned following media reports that information about Kuciak in police databases had been accessed prior to the murders. As an indirect impact of the project, eight top officials including two police presidents were put into custody. A prosecutor was suspended after footage leaked to OCCRP appeared to show him setting up a camera in what looks like his office with someone who appears to be Kočner. He was later charged with abuse of office. Slovak Office for protection of private data threatened investigace.cz with 10 000 000 eur penalty if they wont reveal a source of the footage.
2021-s-0282.authors: Pavla Holcová, Arpád Soltesz, Eva Kubaniova, Friedrich Lindenberg, Jurre Van Bergen, Olga Gein, Martin E., Adriana Homolová
2021-s-0282.summaryJa: 2019年下旬,Ján KuciakとInvestigace.czの調査センターの記者たちは,調査記者ヤン・クシアクと彼の婚約者マーティナ・クシノワの2018年の殺人事件に関する全警察の事件のファイルを取得した.合計53TBの資料,アーカイブには商人マリアン・コックナーと官僚が腐敗した活動に関与した資料が含まれていた. OCCRPのデータと技術チームは膨大な情報量と争いを 4ヶ月かけてブラティスラバでジャーナリストが資料を探索し,オフライン研究のために特定のファイルを確認できる安全なリークルームであるコーナー図書館を設置しました
2021-s-0282.impactJa: ジャーナリストは,信頼されるスロバキアメディアから20人のトップスロバキアジャーナリストを組んでチームを作り,調整しました.このチームは幅広い観客に届くように設計され,優れた調査チームのあらゆる必要性をカバーするために設計されました.日刊,テレビ局,そしてタブロイドのジャーナリストもいました. コックナー図書館の異常な安排により,スロバキアのジャーナリストのチームに漏洩からの情報への自由アクセスを与え,追究し,説明権を持つ手がかりを調査しました.同様に重要なことは,マリアン・コックナー裁判の際に警察のファイルを安全に確保し,自由で公正な司法プロセスを確保することでした.記者たちは,コックナーが公務員への脅迫,賄賂,そして脅迫によって,しばしば彼らとの会議のオーディオとビデオを録音することによって,どのように影響力を確保したか示した. 2020年に複数の突破事件で,スロバキア警察はコッナー氏利益のために裁定するために賄賂を取ったり,敏感な情報を漏洩した最高裁判所の判事を含む20人の判事を逮捕した. 20人の裁判官を除いて憲法裁判官1人がマリアン・コックナーとの関連のため辞任し 1人の破産監事 3人の弁護士 4人の他の人が逮捕されましたスロバキア警察局長と金融犯罪部門の長官は,事件の前に警察データベースのクシアックに関する情報にアクセスされたと報道した.このプロジェクトの間接的な影響として,警察の2人の大統領を含む8人の最高官僚が拘留された. 検察官は,OCCRPに流出した映像で,彼のオフィスにカメラを設置している様子を見せて,コッチナーという人物に見えた後,検察官は停職されました.その後,彼は職務の乱用で起訴されました. スロバキアプライバシー保護局は,映像の源を明らかにしない場合, investigace.czに1万万ユーロの罰金を脅した.

2021-s-0283.summary: Based on the relatively limited daily data published on the Hungarian pandemic website koronamonitor.gov.hu, Koronamonitor aims to point out correlations and information laying in hindsight that the Hungarian government fails to do themselves. Updated every morning, Koronamonitor is an ongoing project of Hungarian two-person data journalism team ATLO. First published days after the virus appeared in Hungary, it has gone through several changes, with diagrams added as the pandemic changed or new information became available. It includes not only informative charts, regional maps and international comparisons, but an interactive virus simulator developed specifically for the site, as well.
2021-s-0283.impact: Since the Hungarian government's pandemic-tracking website offers little to no analytical information, to many citizens, Koronamonitor became the number one source of daily data about the pandemic, offering descriptive and analytical charts based on the text-based data appearing on the governmental website each morning. Many of the changes on the site over time were based on the feedback of our active follower base. During the first wave of the pandemic, the need for understandable and easily-accessable data was vital. This was also visible on the numbers: the site reached one million downloads by the end of June 2020. Altogether, the site was accessed a total of 2245000 individual times, averaging at a daily 10-11 thousand visits. Internationally the site was considered one of the ten most impactful and important data visualization project related to COVID-19 of 2020 by datajournalism.com. We have been honored to be mentioned among legendary newsrooms such as Financial Times, The New York TImes or The Washington Post.
2021-s-0283.tools: QGIS, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2021-s-0283.authors: Attila Bátorfy (main), Krisztián Szabó (main), Tamás Nepusz (simulator), László Horváth (simulator), András Kangyal (Vizzu Explorer), Péter Vidos (Vizzu Explorer)
2021-s-0283.summaryJa: ハンガリー・パンデミック・ウェブサイト koronamonitor.gov.huで掲載されている比較的限られた日々のデータに基づいて,Koronamonitorは,ハンガリー政府が自ら行かないことを示す correlations and information laying in hindsightを指摘することを目指しています. ウイルスがハンガリーに現れた数日後,それはいくつかの変更を経て,パンデミックが変化したときに図面を追加または新しい情報が利用可能になった.
2021-s-0283.impactJa: ハンガリー政府の流行追跡ウェブサイトは多くの市民にとって分析的な情報を提供していないため,コロナモニターは毎日流行に関するデータ源となり,毎朝政府ウェブサイトに掲載されるテキストベースのデータに基づいて記述的および分析的なチャートを提供しました. 流行の第一波では,理解可能で簡単にアクセス可能なデータが必要でした. これは数字でも目立っていました:サイトは2020年6月底までに100万ダウンロードに達しました. 国際的にこのサイトはCOVID-19に関する2020年の10番目に影響力のある重要なデータビジュアライゼーションプロジェクトの一つと考えられています.

2021-s-0284.summary: The government of Kyrgyzstan was planning to spend $645 million on the COVID-19 crisis. Almost all that money is either international aid (both grants and credits) or voluntary donations. However it is offering no detailed information on where the funds are going. Officials say they do not have opportunities to track where do they spend money for COVID-19. Compounding the issue, the country’s public procurement law was quietly changed in the middle of the crisis to ensure still greater secrecy. This project is an attempt to understand how the Kyrgyz state authorities spend money to fight against coronavirus.
2021-s-0284.impact: The main impact is that Kyrgyz authorities have started to report information about the spent money. They started to publish information about received state body, purpose of payment and etc on the website covid.kg (there are still not enough details, but is already a good step). After a while, a commission was created, which began to monitor the distribution of money received to fight the coronavirus. The commission concluded that the money was not used for its purpose and had been stolen.
2021-s-0284.summaryJa: キルギススタン政府はCOVID-19危機に64500万ドルを費やする予定でした.その資金はほぼすべて国際援助 (補助金とクレジットの両方) またはボランティア寄付です.しかし,資金がどこに行くのかについては詳細な情報を提供していません.当局者は,COVID-19のためにお金をどこに費やしているのかを追跡する機会がないと語っています. 危機の真っ只中に,国の公共調達法が静かに変更され,さらに大きな秘密を保ちましたこのプロジェクトは,キルギス州の当局がコロナウイルス対策にどのようにお金を費やしているのかを理解しようと試みています.
2021-s-0284.impactJa: 影響は,キルギス当局が支出金に関する情報を報告し始めたこと. 受け取った国体,支払目的などに関する情報をcovid.kgウェブサイトに公開し始めたこと (まだ詳細は十分ではないが,すでに良いステップです). しばらくして,コロナウイルス対策のために受け取った金分配を監視する委員会が設立された. 委員会は,その目的に使われず,盗まれたと結論しました.

2021-s-0285.summary: The former tribal areas, now merged with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, have experienced military operations, conflict and displacement at a massive scale over the past decade. The area has been one of the focal points for the war on terror and continues to suffer from the effects of the conflict and years of neglect before that. Due to the operation in 2014 alone, about 929,859 people from north Waziristan were forced to flee their homes, becoming Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs). After the conflict. Those returning to the area, felt the stark difference in connectivity is leading to deaths.
2021-s-0285.impact: After covid-19 hit Pakistan the situation of internet services in tribal areas got highlighted, students were campaigning on social media to highlight connectivity issues at that time, I took my journalistic responsibility and gathered data on issues faced by tribal women under covid-19 tribal areas do not have proper hospitals, with staff overburdened in the limited health facilities that do exist. News reports over the years have documented the difficulty most residents have in reaching healthcare in cases of emergence, poor communication infrastructure makes it even more difficult for residents to call for health care service I interviewed many people including local journalist Raziya Mehsud she revealed that “The whole world is using different techniques to fight with COVID-19 through the internet but many of the tribal women do not even know about COVID-19, If a woman dies of COVID-19, she or even her family don’t know what has happened to her.” Raziya added that where people in other countries are using the internet to innovate during the pandemic, find solutions to social, medical or political problems that have risen as a result of lockdowns, people in Waziristan are still looking to the government for basic connectivity. The article was published in Digital rights monitor followed by a live session, which created enormous response people of Pakistan started asking the government about health facilities in former fata and other tribal areas, which weren’t having internet facility to be able to held government responsible in the time of pandemic. The article made rounds on social media which pressurized government think to for tribal people, medical teams and kits were dispatched for tribal areas in a very short time. I humbly state that this article saved many precious lives in Pakistan which were vulnerable in covid-19.
2021-s-0285.tools: Animation, Personalisation, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
2021-s-0285.summaryJa: 旧部族地域が,現在ハイバーパクチュンフワと合併した地域は,過去10年間で大規模な軍事作戦,紛争,避難を経験した.この地域はテロとの戦争の中心地の一つであり,それ以前の紛争と長年の無視の影響で苦しんでいる.2014年の作戦だけで,北部・ワジリスタンから約929,859人が家を出たため,国内避難民 (IDP) になった. 紛争後地域に戻った人々は接続性の大きな違いが死に繋がっていると感じました
2021-s-0285.impactJa: コビッド-19がパキスタンに襲われた後部族地域のインターネットサービスが明るみに出た学生たちはソーシャルメディアで接続性問題を強調するためにキャンペーンをしていました私はジャーナリストとしての責任を取ってコビッド-19の部族地域の部族の女性が直面する問題に関するデータを集めました <a href="https://mandrillapp.com/track/click/30284241/www.tnn.com.pk?p=eyJzIjoiMHFMMl9MRDBwUDNPTVl3ZUlGS1NBR3ZESlRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR 緊急事態の発生時に医療へのアクセスが困難であるという事実を過去数年間にわたって記録してきました. コミュニケーションインフラが悪くなって医療サービスに電話をするのはさらに困難です. ローカルジャーナリストラジア・メフスードを含む多くの人とインタビューした. コーディッド-19の感染について,彼女や彼女の家族は,彼女自身に何が起こったのか知らない. ラージアは,他の国々の人々が,流行の間,インターネットを利用して革新し,ロックダウンの結果として増加した社会,医療,政治的問題への解決策を探しているところ, ワジリスタンの人々は依然として基本的な接続性のために政府に頼っていると付け加えた. デジタル権利モニター誌に掲載された記事に続いて,ライブセッションが開催され, パキスタンの人々は,前死亡者および他の部族地域の保健施設について政府に尋ね始めました. この記事はソーシャルメディアで広まり,政府に部族の人々を考えるよう圧力をかけた. 医療チームやキットが非常に短時間で部族地域へ送られてきた. この記事で,COVID-19で脆弱だったパキスタンでは多くの貴重な命が救われたことを謙虚に述べます.

2021-s-0286.summary: This investigative story looked into the quality of fresh fish that is being sold in the supermarkets. Lab tests showed that 25% of the fish was not good quality: the fish was so old the rotting bacteria levels had grown over the limits. Another big problem we encountered, was that it’s really hard to find out when the fish was catch. When asked, the sellers often told the day they received it. Time between catching and receiving can be anything up to 10 days. By the law, the fish sellers, don’t have to have the catch day displayed.
2021-s-0286.impact: The story was published just before Christmas when people were thinking which fish to buy for the holidays. Many were shocked of the results and we got tons of feedback – this time 95% positive, readers thanking for the good service journalism. We even got thanks from the national health inspectors. Some fish sellers told they will check/change the suppliers. Readers learn the importance of asking the catching day.
2021-s-0286.authors: Pauliina Siniauer, Katja Nordlund, Boris Stefanov, Jukka Himanen, Sanna Maskulin
2021-s-0286.summaryJa: この調査報告ではスーパーマーケットで販売されている新鮮な魚の質を調べました. 実験室検査では,魚の25%が質素でないことが示されました.魚はあまりに古いので,腐った細菌のレベルが限界を超えていました.また,私たちが直面した大きな問題は,魚が捕まった時期を本当に知ることは困難でした.尋ねられたとき,販売者はしばしば受け取った日を述べました.捕獲と受け取る間の時間は10日までです. 法律では魚を売る者は釣りの日を表示する必要はありません
2021-s-0286.impactJa: この記事はクリスマス前,人々が休暇にどの魚を買おうか考えていた時,公開されました.多くの方が結果にショックを受け,私たちは多くのフィードバックを得ました. 今回は95%のポジティブです.読者は良いサービスジャーナリズムに感謝しています.私たちは国家保健検査官からも感謝を受けました.一部の魚販売者はサプライヤーをチェック/変更すると言いました.読者は捕獲日を尋ねる重要性を学びます.

2021-s-0287.summary: The Project was borne out curiosity to inform the society on h Engineer Seyi Makinde's government engaged contractors for unspecified projects, this time 42 of them worth ₦5 billion; The Oyo State Bureau of Public Procurement (Oyo BPP) has some questions to answer for publishing expenditure with unactionable data, from location to quantity; Not to mention this act contravened the state's public open contracting and procurement regulations; In all, while the state's adoption of open contracting is laudable, it's the finer details that scream the loudest; thus, championing transparency to its fullest extent is the way to go for Governor
2021-s-0287.impact: The story became one of the top twenty stories published by Dataphyte in the year 2020, The project has also raised people's consciousness to ask the government the right questions in demanding for openness in governance.
2021-s-0287.summaryJa: プロジェクトには,社会に情報提供の好奇心が示され, エンジニア・セイ・マキンドの政府が指定されていないプロジェクトに請負業者を雇った. 今回は42個が55億ドル.オイオ州公共調達局 (Oyo BPP) は,場所から量まで,不可動なデータで支出を公表するためのいくつかの質問に答えなければならない. 透明性を最大限に擁護することは州長にとって素晴らしいことです
2021-s-0287.impactJa: この記事は2020年にデータファイテが発表したトップ20の記事の一つになりましたこのプロジェクトは政府への公开な統治の要求において正しい質問を問う人々の意識を高めました

2021-s-0288.summary: The story is an expose of how the Oyo State government has left some main roads in Ibadan the state Capital, even though the government has claims to focus on eradicating potholes problems in the state. The story further dwells on how the road users have been groaning because of the bad state of their road and a searchlight should be beamed into government spending as far as road constructions are concerned
2021-s-0288.impact: Since information is the bedrock of all policies and decisions any governments make, the story through its data presentation has opened the Oyo state resident eyes to ask questions of accountability and transparency. More so the project still remains one of the top stories published by the media organisation for the year 2020.
2021-s-0288.summaryJa: この物語は,オイオ州政府が州首都イバダンにあるいくつかの主要道路をどのように残したかを明らかにしています. 政府が州内の穴穴問題を解決することに焦点を当てると主張しているにもかかわらず.この物語は,道路の不良状態のために道路利用者がどのように嘆いているかについてさらに述べています.道路建設に関して,政府の支出に検索ランプを投射すべきです.
2021-s-0288.impactJa: 情報はあらゆる政府による政策や決定の基盤であるため,そのデータ発表を通じて,この記事はオイオ州住民の目を開いて,説明責任と透明性の問題に取り組むようになりました.さらにこのプロジェクトは2020年のメディア機関が公表したトップ記事の一つに留まっています.

2021-s-0289.summary: It is an exclusive map that gathers data on cases and deaths from Covid-19 in all Brazilian municipalities, numbers and the moving average of cases and deaths in the 27 states of the country and the records in all countries in the world. A journalistic investigation that involves more than 100 reporters and whose update is done almost in real time.
2021-s-0289.impact: It is the most complete tool available to the public in Brazil. G1 was able to gather data from all cities in real time and make available the information of the consortium of press vehicles (formed after the federal government threatened to restrict the data), clearly and precisely, giving the dimension of disease in each location. The map became the great source of information in the midst of the pandemic of the new coronavirus, becoming a daily issue in all the press and reference media because of its showing on Jornal Nacional, on TV Globo, daily, and on local news. With different views, the map manages, in three different tabs, to inform and allows comparisons between cities, states and countries around the world. It innovates by standardizing the concept of moving average and making the population understand the dynamics of the disease in Brazil, with simple and complete graphics. The work involves the participation of more than 100 journalists from the 27 states of the country, responsible for the daily collection of data from all 5,570 cities by the health departments. An arduous and detailed investigation, which seeks to provide transparency to numbers that are often hidden or not disclosed to the general population.
2021-s-0289.tools: QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, Node.js
2021-s-0289.summaryJa: これは,ブラジル各自治体でCOVID-19による症例と死亡,27州で症例と死亡の移動平均と世界のすべての国の記録に関するデータを集めた独占地図です.100人以上のジャーナリストを対象としたジャーナリズムの調査で,ほぼリアルタイムで更新されています.
2021-s-0289.impactJa: G1はブラジルで最も完全なツールです. G1はすべての都市からのデータをリアルタイムで収集し,各地域における疾患の規模を明確に正確に示すために,プレス車両コンソーシアムの情報 (連邦政府がデータを制限すると脅した後に設立された) を公開しました. 新型コロナウイルスの流行中に地図は,ジャーナルナショナル,テレビグローボ,デイリー,そして地元のニュースで表示されるため,すべてのマスコミや参考メディアで日常的な問題となり,新しいコロナウイルスの流行中に大きな情報源となった.異なる視点で,地図は,異なるタブで,世界中の都市,州,国間の比較を情報化し,許可することができます. ブラジルでは,移動平均という概念を標準化し,人口に単純な完全なグラフィックを使って,ブラジルの疾患の動態を理解させることで革新を遂げています.この作業には,国の27州から100人以上のジャーナリストが参加し,健康部門がすべての5570都市からの毎日データを収集する責任があります. 難しい詳細な調査で一般市民に隠された数値や公開されていない数字の透明性を提供しようとしています

2021-s-0290.summary: Since the beginning of the coronavirus pandemic, data about cases in a local level has been arduous to reach. At elDiario.es, we created an exclusive database of COVID-19 cases in each municipality of Spain and presented the data as an interactive map that is updated once per week. To build this project we collect the data from each of the 17 regions (more than 5000 municipalities) Spain has, who publish the data in different formats. This publication is performing a public service that neither the government or other media outlets are doing.
2021-s-0290.impact: During the first months of the coronavirus pandemic, only six Spanish regions were activly publishing the data of coronavirus cases registered in their municipalities. The publication of our map, our persistence calling each regional goverment everyday and the request of our readers for more data influenced the goverments to start publishing this dissagregated local data. The publication of our map works as an early warning systema for citizens and authorities, who can notice if the situation in their city is dangerous before all its region is affected or the global indicators published by the government can portray the danger. Moreover, the data is published in an aggregated way and this allows comparisons between cities. The weekly ranking of coronavirus incidence in the main Spanish cities is one of our most shared charts week after week (even by other news media, as seen at link 3). Even city council members has shared the publication to raise awareness on the the situation in their cities or are surprised by the data we published because their local goverments are not delivering the information as fast as we are doing it.
2021-s-0290.tools: D3.js, JQuery, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio
2021-s-0290.authors: Raúl Sánchez, Ana Ordaz, Victòria Oliveres
2021-s-0290.summaryJa: コロナウイルス・パンデミックの始まり以来,地方レベルでの症例に関するデータは入手困難でした. elDiario.esでは,スペインの各自治体で COVID-19 の症例に関する独占データベースを作成し,データを週に1回更新するインタラクティブな地図として提示しました.このプロジェクトを構築するために,私たちはスペインが持っている17の地域 (5,000以上の自治体) のそれぞれからデータを収集しています.彼らはデータを異なる形式で公開します. この出版物は政府や他のメディアがしていない公共の奉仕を行っています
2021-s-0290.impactJa: コロナウイルス・パンデミックの最初の数ヶ月間にスペインの6つの地域だけが地域内で登録されたコロナウイルス病例のデータを積極的に公開していました私たちの地図の公開,毎日各地域政府に電話する私たちの持続,より多くのデータへの読者の要請は,政府にこの分散した地域データを公開するよう影響を与えた. The publication of our mapは市民や当局のための早期警告システムとして機能し,その地域全体が影響を受ける前に市内の状況が危険であるかどうかを認識できるし,政府によって公表されたグローバル指標が危険を描くことができる. スペインの主要都市におけるコロナウイルス感染率の週刊ランキングは,週ごとに最もシェアされたチャートの一つです (他のニュースメディアでも見られる). 市議会メンバーでさえ,彼らの都市における状況について認識を高めるために,または彼らの地方政府が私たちがやっているほど早く情報を配信していないため,私たちが公表したデータに驚いています.

2021-s-0291.summary: This project was designed to track the impact of Coronavirus across the African continent. At the onset of the pandemic, we realised it was very difficult to get accurate information about how the virus was spreading within Africa. This tool was created to tell that story, with daily updates of confirmed cases, deaths, recoveries and number of tests carried out in 54 African countries. Overall numbers, a map of Africa visualising confirmed cases in each country, an interactive bar chart race showing how confirmed cases in each co The project also includes a link to The Elephant's edition on the
2021-s-0291.impact: Over the past year, the project has been viewed over 150,000 times from 135 countries around the world. The audience that engaged with this tracker used it mostly to compare the status of the pandemic in different African countries as well as research.
2021-s-0291.tools: Animation, Scraping, JQuery, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2021-s-0291.authors: Alan Kawamara, Juliet Atellah, Salma Mwangola
2021-s-0291.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,アフリカ大陸全体でコロナウイルスの影響を追跡するために設計された.この流行の始まりに,私たちは,ウイルスがアフリカ内でどのように広がっているのかについて正確な情報を得ることは非常に困難であることを認識しました.このツールは,確認された症例,死亡,回復,およびアフリカ54カ国で実施された検査の数に関する日常更新を記録し,その話を伝えるために作成されました. 総数,各国の確認症例を視覚化するアフリカ地図,各国の確認症例のやり方を示すインタラクティブなバーチャートレース
2021-s-0291.impactJa: このプロジェクトは過去1年以内に世界135カ国から15万回以上閲覧された.このトラッカーを使用した視聴者は主にアフリカ諸国における流行病状況と調査を比較するために使用した.

2021-s-0292.summary: East Kalimantan has been selected to be Indonesia's new capital, but developing a new capital city could come with environmental damages to the region. We focused on the Irrawaddy dolphin, an endangered species that inhabit the Balikpapan Bay and the Mahakam River. They have faced threats over the past decade, including oil spills, increasing ship traffic, and fishing activities. Through interactive charts and maps, this project explains and visualizes the threats that the Irrawaddy dolphins have faced and how the new capital will threaten their habitats even further. This project was funded by the Indonesian Data Journalism Network and the
2021-s-0292.impact: This project helped to increase awareness to Indonesians about the Irrawaddy dolphin population and how the development of the new capital needs to be more sustainable and take into account the habitats of the Irrawaddy dolphins and other marine and freshwater animals. It generated a lot of interest on social media, because it's the first time that anyone has ever done a comprehensive, interactive and very visual explanation of East Kalimantan's most beloved icon. While the Irrawaddy dolphins are very well-known in East Kalimantan, many Indonesians aren't aware of their endangered status. Since we were able to get the project published in Kompas, one of Indonesia's largest national newspapers, we brought awareness to this issue to people outside of Kalimantan. In addition, we are also working on an English version of this story to be published very soon on Internews' Earth Journalism Network, one of the organizations that awarded the grant for this project.
2021-s-0292.tools: D3.js, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, Node.js
2021-s-0292.authors: Stephanie Adeline, Zakarias Demon Daton, Syaifudin
2021-s-0292.summaryJa: 東カリマンタンはインドネシアの新しい首都に選ばれたが,新しい首都を開発することは,地域に環境の害を及ぼしています.我々はバリカパパン湾とマハカム川に住む絶滅に瀕するイルカイラワディに注目しました.過去 10 年間,石油流出,船舶交通増加,漁業などの脅威に直面していました. このプロジェクトでは,イラワディイルカが直面している脅威や,新しい首都が彼らの棲息地をさらに脅かす方法について,インタラクティブなチャートや地図を通じて説明し,視覚化しています.
2021-s-0292.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,イルカの集団について,そして新しい首都の発展がより持続可能なものになることが必要であるかを,イルカの棲息地や他の海洋および淡水動物の居住地を考慮に入れることを,インドネシア人の認識を高めることに役立ちました. イラワディイルカは東カリマンタンでは知られていますが多くのインドネシア人は絶滅危惧種の状況に気づいていないのです私たちはこのプロジェクトをインドネシア最大の新聞 Kompasで公開し広報を進めましたさらにこの記事の英語版も開発中ですこのプロジェクトに寄付をくれた組織の一つであるインターニュースの地球ジャーナリズムネットワークですぐ公開されます

2021-s-0293.summary: Infographic about the record of goals in the same club that Leo Messi achieved by equaling the 643 goals of Pele, in the infographic all his goals are detailed match by match. We made two versions of the project, web and paper, I attach the paper version in links.
2021-s-0293.impact: In the home of Mundo Deportivo it was one of the most viewed news of the day, on social networks it had a lot of recognition and the tweet we made works very well.
2021-s-0293.tools: JQuery, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2021-s-0293.authors: Infographis: Ferran Morales / Data: Gabriel Sans
2021-s-0293.summaryJa: プレの643ゴールを等しくすることでレオ・メッシが達成した同じクラブでのゴール記録に関する情報です詳細は彼のゴールがすべてです試合ごとに. 私たちはプロジェクトの2つのバージョン,ウェブと紙を作りました.
2021-s-0293.impactJa: メディアは,この日のニュースの中で最も視聴されているニュースの一つで,ソーシャルメディアでは,多くの評価を得ており,私たちが作ったツイートはとてもうまく機能しています.

2021-s-0294.summary: Pregnancy termination is such a stereotyped issue that 59% of the mexican population would incarcerate women who have had a miscarriage… in a country where 14 out of every thousand women have had a miscarriage. This happens because we have built a distorted image around chosen reproduction and sexual freedom; however, when we subject the pregnancy, marriage, contraception, and birth indicators to statistical analysis, we find a reality of fewer "irresponsible women" and more about "male rapists". And that's where we have to look when we speak of abortion: at men.
2021-s-0294.impact: After applying big data to the 32 criminal codes of the Mexican Republic, as well as to all open government information on the exercise of maternity/paternity in the country, we found that Mexico still legally allows men to establish sexual relationships with girls up to 12 years old and to marry minors. This cuases that 1 in 6 pregnancies are the product of a rape, women make up 78.28% of the people who are forced to live as a couple during childhood, and 1 in 3 male adults force the first sexual encounter with minors, highlighting the problem of the pedophilia. The debate on abortion then ceases to be an "ethical" issue to become one of social security, legislation, criminalistics, and health, which is why at least 126 national and international organizations have already incorporated the findings of this study into their information records after they were published. Likewise, when disaggregating the main myths around the chosen reproduction and all the causes that criminalize abortion in the 32 states of the Mexican Republic, we discovered that there are territories where saving the mother's life is paid with jail, only 3 of every 100 men have a vasectomy, and about 32 adoption requests are made in Mexico, per year. Therefore, the "pro-life" discourse falls apart, resulting in this research going viral until it reached 505,360 impacts in just a few weeks.
2021-s-0294.summaryJa: 妊娠中絶はステレオタイプの問題でメキシコの人口の 59%が堕胎した女性を投獄する妊娠,結婚,避妊,出生指標を統計分析すると "無責任な女性"が少なく "男性レイプ者"が多くなるという現実が見られます堕胎について語るときは男性を対象とするものです
2021-s-0294.impactJa: メキシコ共和国の32の刑事法典と国内の妊産婦・父親権行使に関する公开政府の情報に大規模なデータを適用した後メキシコは依然として 12歳までの少女と性的関係を確立し未成年者と結婚することを合法的に許していることがわかりましたこれは,6人の妊娠のうち"つがレイプの結果であり子どもの間に夫婦として生活することを余儀なくされる人の78.28%が女性であり 3人の男性のうち"人は未成年者と初めて性的接触を強制し恋愛問題を強調しています堕胎に関する議論は"倫理的"問題ではなく社会保障,立法,犯罪学,健康の問題となり少なくとも126の国家・国際機関がこの研究の結果を公表後,すでに情報記録に組み込んでいる. 同様にメキシコ共和国の32州で妊娠中絶を犯罪に認める主な神話と選択された生殖に関する神話を分散させるとメキシコ共和国の32州で母親の命を救うことが刑務所で支払われる地域があることが分かり 100人の男性のうち 3人がヴァゼクトミーを受けるだけでメキシコでは毎年 32人の養子縁組申請が行われています "生命の支持"という議論は崩壊し数週間で 505,360人の影響に達するまでこの研究が流行り始めました

2021-s-0295.summary: 161,170. That's how many passports Russian authorities issued to foreigners between January and March in 2020. It's more than twice the number that the country issued during the same period in 2019. In April 2020, President Vladimir Putin also signed a dual-citizenship law that estimates suggest will attract up to 10 million new citizens. Why? According to the most pessimistic scenarios, Russia's population might drop by 12 million in the next 15 years and Putin has made reversing the country's demographic crisis a major priority.
2021-s-0295.impact: The project helped our English speaking audience to better understand the demography crisis that Russia is dealing with. When Russian President Vladimir Putin assumed office, Russia was losing around half a million people each year. While the country has been trying to boost fertility rates and implement special programs for families, perhaps the most successful strategy has been attracting migrants, whose arrival helps Russia to compensate population losses. According to some studies, Eastern European countries are among those with the least-accepting attitudes towards migrants, yet inviting people from other countries seems to be working for Russia. The microsite reached more than 100k people on our Facebook page and it was later translated to two other languages (Kazakh and Tajik) so it reached an even bigger audience. It also inspired other language services of the RFE/RL to create similar projects.
2021-s-0295.tools: Animation, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel
2021-s-0295.summaryJa: 161,170. これは2020年1月から3月までの間にロシア当局が外国人に発行したパスポートの数です. 2019年の同期間に発行されたパスポートの2倍以上です. 2020年4月にプーチン大統領は,さらに二重国籍法に署名しました. 悲観的なシナリオではロシアの人口は今後15年間で 1200万人に減少する可能性があるとプーチンは国の人口危機を逆転させることが優先事項となっている
2021-s-0295.impactJa: このプロジェクトは英語圏の観客にロシアが直面している人口危機をよりよく理解するのに役立ちます. プーチン大統領が大統領に就任した時,ロシアは毎年50万人近くを失っていました. 国が生育率を上げ,家族のための特別プログラムを実施しようと試みている一方で,おそらく最も成功した戦略は移民を誘い込むことであり,その到着はロシアに人口損失を補うのに役立つでしょう. ヨーロッパのいくつかの研究によると,東欧諸国には移民に対する態度が最も低いものの,他の国からの人を招待することはロシアのために働くようです.マイクロサイトはFacebookページで100,000人を超える人に届きました. その後,他の2つの言語 (カザフ語とタジキ語) に翻訳され,さらに大きな視聴者に届きました.

2021-s-0296.summary: In 2020, CIN investigated the misuse of natural resources in BiH. Our reporters discovered illegal construction in the protected areas, illegal gravel mining from BiH rivers, which led to floods causing damages estimated in millions, illegal logging in the Olympic mountains, detrimental effects of dozens of small HPPs erected on BiH rivers, harmful contracts incentivizing power generation from RES causing millions in damages, which citizens paid through their electricity bills, mostly not being aware of it. The data collected during the research were pooled in the two online data. Everything was published from March 17 to December 29, 2020.
2021-s-0296.impact: Following the release of our story on exploitation and illegal gravel mining from BiH rivers, the private companies involved in these activities did not have their contracts extended. Based on facts presented in the stories, the competent inspectors announced pressing charges and launching the investigations of the Ministry of the Interior. Following our story about illegal construction and illegal land clearing in the BiH Olympic mountain Bjelašnica approved by the local municipal government for the purpose of constructing a sports center, the Sarajevo Canton Government stopped co-financing od the project worth EUR 1.3 million. The competent inspection authority fined and pressed charges against the company which not only conducted clear-cutting but also illegally sold the timber logs. According to collected data, in the period 2015-2020, owners of the private power plants have been paid at least EUR 100 million in incentives for power generation from renewable energy sources. The huge sums of money monthly paid by citizens through their electricity bills have turned power generation from RES into a lucrative business with little investment and a lot of harm to the environment. The investigation revealed that citizens are not at all aware of the fact that they have been paying these incentives through their electricity bills. Following the release of the story, citizens launched an initiative on social networks calling a boycott against the payment of these fees.
2021-s-0296.tools: Animation, Drone, Scraping, D3.js, JQuery, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2021-s-0296.authors: Team of the Center for Investigative Reporting (CIN)
2021-s-0296.summaryJa: 2020年にCINは,BHにおける自然資源の悪用について調査した. 保護区で違法な建設,BIH川から違法な砂岩採掘が発見され,洪水で何百万人もの損害がもたらされ,オリンピック山で違法な伐採,BiH川に建てられた数十の小さなHPPの有害な影響, RESから発電を奨励する有害な契約で何百万人もの損害がもたらされ,市民が電気請求書で支払った損害はほとんど意識していない. 調査中に収集されたデータは2つのオンラインデータにまとめられました.すべては2020年3月17日から12月29日まで公開されました.
2021-s-0296.impactJa: ニュースで紹介された事実に基づいて,有権検査官は起訴を申し立て,内務省の調査を開始することを発表した. セルビア州自治体がスポーツセンターの建設のために地方自治体が承認したビヘリオリンピーク山の違法建設と違法な土地清掃に関する我々の話を続き,サラエボ・カンタン政府は1300万ユーロのプロジェクトの共同資金提供を停止しました. 有権な検査機関が,清掃を行うだけでなく,木材の木材を違法に販売した会社に対して罰金を課し,起訴した. 収集されたデータによると,2015-2020年期間中,民間発電所の所有者は再生可能エネルギー源から発電のための少なくとも1億ユーロのインセンティブを支払った.市民が電気請求書で毎月支払った膨大な金額は, RESから発電を投資が少ないと環境への害が多くなる収益性の高い事業に変えた. 市民は電気代でインセンティブを支払っているという事実に全く気づいていないことが明らかになった.このニュースが公開された後,市民はソーシャルメディアでこの手数料の支払いを拒否するボイコットを呼びかけ,イニシアチブを開始した.

2021-s-0297.summary: My Little Crony is an interactive visualization of the connections between Tory politicians and companies being awarded government contracts during the pandemic. Users can explore this interlocking web for themselves and click through to read the underlying investigative reporting.
2021-s-0297.impact: While there had been a great deal of excellent investigative reporting on the procurement scandal -- typically by small outlets like Byline Times and OpenDemocracy -- it was receiving relatively little coverage by the larger newspapers and by broadcast media. I think that the main impact of "My Little Crony" was to bundle these stories together into one simple conclusion: this is cronyism. "My Little Crony" was covered by the Metro and City A.M. and discussed on BBC Radio 4 and LBC. It was also shared widely on social networking sites like Twitter and Reddit. I wrote op-eds for Byline Times and the Guardian describing how I made the visualization and why this procurement scandal matters. Valerie Vaz, the Shadow Leader of the House of Commons, cited "My Little Crony" in parliament and told her opposite number, Jacob Rees-Mogg, that it was "well worth a look". Rachel Reeves, the Shadow Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, wrote on Twitter that the visualization "raises far too many links for the government to ignore". I encouraged users of "My Little Crony" to sign a petition calling for a public inquiry into public contracts awarded during the pandemic. While I can't make any strong claims about a causal impact (!), the petition crossed the 100,000 signature threshold a few days after "My Little Crony" was launched, meaning that it will be debated in parliament.

2021-s-0297.impactJa: 買取スキャンダルについて優れた調査報告が多くありました典型的にはビラインタイムズやオープン・デモクラシーのような小さなメディアが報道していたのですが報道は比較的少ない大きい新聞や放送メディアは "My Little Crony"は"https://metro.co.uk/2020/11/13/my-little-crony-map-shows-deals-between-government-mps-and-tory-donors-13587900/#metro-comments-container">Metroと City A.M.で取り上げられ,BBC Radio 4とLBCで議論された. ソーシャルメディアのサイトでも広く共有されました Twitter と Reddit. バイリンタイムズとコメンテンスフリー/2020/nov/21/tories-covid-contracts-public-trust-governmentの記事でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズとガードヤンに書いた文章でバイリンタイムズがどう描いたのかバイリン・スカンダルはなぜ重要なのか描写した文章で衆議院院の影のリーダーであるヴァレリー・バズ (Valerie Vaz) は,議会で"My Little Crony"を引用し,反対番号のジェイコブ・リーズ・モグ (Jacob Rees-Mogg) に"よく見るべき"だと語った. ラチェル・リーブス (Rachel Reeves) は,ランカスター公爵国の影の総理大臣がツイッターで"このビジュアライゼーションは政府に無視できないリンクを多く増やしている"と書いた.私は"マイ・リトル・クロニー"のユーザーを"パンデミック中に授与された公共契約について公的な調査を要請する請願書に署名するよう促した. 理由による影響について強く主張することはできませんが (!), 請願は"マイ・リトル・クロニー"が開始された数日後,署名10万の限界を超え,議会で議論される.

2021-s-0298.summary: By using open source information and the Russian black data market we were able to uncover the FSB team that poisoned Russian opposition leader Alexey Navalny, the structure of the operation all the way to the top, and the clandestine chemical weapons programme of the Russian government. For this purpose we analysed large amounts of data - phone records, traveling information, et al., and revealed - perhaps in an unprecedented manner, certainly more widely then ever - the capability and the dangers of free flowing data, as well as the ways this information is used and sold by corrupted officials.
2021-s-0298.impact: The story has been on the forefront of the world news and has major ramifications for Russia. The project led to several calls for further investigations and sanctions. Our team has been called to testify in the British Parliament, The Council of Europe, and of the leading members of the US Congress has expressed a wish to summon us after the pandemic. The European Parliament has issued a motion where our investigation is explicitly mentioned as the cause for further action against Putin's regime. The latter has also commented on the story calling it a "legalisation" of "foreign intelligence" - on one hand proving its veracity, on the other unwillingly complementing our data gathering efforts to be at the level of an intelligence service.
2021-s-0298.authors: Christo Grozev, Aric Toler, Pieter van Huis, Yordan Tsalov, Roman Dobrokhotov
2021-s-0298.summaryJa: オープンソース情報とロシアのブラックデータ市場を使ってロシアの野党指導者アレキッシー・ナバレーを毒にした FSBチーム作戦の構造を突き止めることができましたロシア政府の秘密の化学兵器プログラムですその目的のために私たちは大量のデータを分析しました電話記録旅行情報などですそしておそらく前例のない方法で明らかにしました明らかにこれまで以上に広くデータの自由な流通の能力と危険性そして腐敗した当局者がこの情報を活用し売る方法も明らかにしました
2021-s-0298.impactJa: この事件は世界ニュースの一番の話題となり,ロシアにとって大きな影響をもたらした.このプロジェクトはさらなる調査と制裁を要請するいくつかの呼びかけをもたらした.我々のチームはイギリス議会,欧州理事会,そして米国の議会の主要なメンバーに証言するために呼ばれ,大流行後に我々を呼び出すことを願った. 欧州議会は,我々の調査をプーチン政権に対するさらなる行動の理由として明示的に言及する提案を提出した.プーチン政権は,これを"外国情報"の"合法化"と呼ぶ話もコメントした.

2021-s-0299.summary: The story details how the 100 largest law firms in the country have responded to the Covid-19 pandemic, a health crisis and economic downturn that has brought chaos to the legal industry.
