Our investigation also sparked renewed political calls for more regulation for short-term rentals in the UK. Prompted by our exclusive story, Green MP Caroline Lucas said local councils should be given the power to impose a 90-day cap on homes let out on Airbnb and similar platforms. Our story was also picked up by local media in Scotland where we identified the highest Airbnb rates in the country.
2021-s-0338.authors: Niko Kommenda, Helen Pidd and Libby Brooks
2021-s-0338.summaryJa: この独占的な分析のために,私はイギリス全域で25万件のAirbnbのリストを公式の住宅株式数値と比較し,住宅のリストの割合が過度に高い場所を見つけました.この物語の静的・インタラクティブなグラフィックでは,読者が全国的なイメージを示し,地域に関する数字を調査できるようにしました. 分析は,イングランドとスコットランドのホットスポットから現地報告が続いており,短期賃貸の割合が高いことが不動産価格を上昇させ,地域社会を混乱させ,しばしば若い地元住民が問題のある地域を離れることを示しています.
2021-s-0338.impactJa: 記事の主題は,印刷紙の前ページに載っており,オンラインで20万回以上閲覧された.出版後,私は2つの全国ラジオ番組で,分析の結果を議論するよう招待された.放送局はAirbnbのホットスポット近くに住む人々や不動産所有者に招待し,非常に興味深い議論をもたらした. 調査は英国で短期賃貸の規制を再開させるための新たな政治的呼びかけも起こしました. <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2020/feb/21/airbnb-call-english-councils-powers-regulate-caroline-lucas">我々の独占的な物語によって促され,グリーン議員キャロライン・ルーカスは,地方議会にAirbnbおよび類似のプラットフォームで出荷された住宅に90日間制限を課す権限を与えられなければならないと発言しました. ニュース/18251729. 懸念が引き上げられたエアbnb拡大エディンブルグスコットランドの地元のメディアも紹介しました

2021-s-0339.summary: Emma Youle’s work for HuffPost UK this year has focused on anti-corruption and investigative reporting, particularly holding the government to account over Covid-19 spending. In this investigation, Emma revealed significant new information about deals done by the UK government to buy personal protective equipment (PPE) and testing equipment. She exposed details of huge contracts being handed to dormant companies – and one £186m PPE deal awarded to a firm whose multi-millionaire owner is listed as a speaker for an influential pro-Brexit lobby group associated with cabinet ministers in the UK.
2021-s-0339.impact: Emma’s rigorous reporting exposed allegations of cronyism and a lack of government transparency, and prompted demands for a public inquiry into the UK government’s spending under emergency Covid-19 procurement powers. This investigation revealed previously hidden information about one of the most significant areas of public spending for decades, placing scrutiny on the government. The story led Apple News’ coveted top story spot and had among the highest readership figures seen by HuffPost UK for an investigation of this type: almost 750,000 page views. Emma preceded this investigation with exclusive reports about the secrecy she encountered around government spending on the UK's temporary Nightingale hospitals. Influential watchdog the Public Accounts Committee has since criticised the government over this lack of transparency, vindicating Emma’s work. A High Court legal case is currently underway in the UK challenging the government over its alleged repeated failure to publish details of these coronavirus-related contracts, collectively worth tens of billions of pounds. The case claims this failure was unlawful and in breach of the government’s own transparency rules.
2021-s-0339.summaryJa: エマ・ユーレの今年の HuffPost UKでの仕事は,反汚職と調査報告に焦点を当て,特に政府をCOVID-19支出について説明することでした.この調査で,エマは個人保護用品 (PPE) と検査用品を購入するために英国政府がした取引に関する重要な新しい情報を明らかにしました. グレゴールは,英国内閣大臣と関連している影響力のあるブレグジット支持ロビーグループのスピーカーとして数百万富翁のオーナーが登録されている会社に186万ポンドのPPE取引が認められたという詳細を明らかにした.
2021-s-0339.impactJa: エマの厳格な報告は,親密主義と政府の透明性の欠如の疑惑を暴露し,緊急のCOVID-19調達権限の下で英国政府の支出に関する公的な調査を要求しました.この調査は,数十年にわたって公的な支出で最も重要な分野の一つに関する以前に隠された情報を明らかにし,政府を監視しました. このニュースは,Apple Newsの熱望なトップニュース・スポットに導かれ,このタイプの調査のためにHuffPost UKが見た読者の割合が最も高い:ほぼ75万ページビュー.エマは,この調査の前に,英国の一時的なナイトインゲル病院への政府支出に関する秘密に関する独占的な報告で,調査を前にした. 影響力の高い監視団体である公会計委員会 (Public Accounts Committee) は,この透明性の欠如で政府を批判し,エマ<unk>の活動を正当化している.現在,英国では,この数十億ドルもの総額を合計して10億ドルものコロナウイルス関連契約の詳細を公表していないとされているとの疑いで政府に挑戦する高等裁判所の訴訟が進行中.この事件は,この失敗が違法であり,政府の透明性規則を違反していると主張している.

2021-s-0340.summary: The Road to 270 project is a top-of-its-kind interactive electoral college map tool that also helped narrate the course of the 2020 presidential election in realtime.
2021-s-0340.impact: Road to 270 let readers understand the permutations of possible electoral college vote combinations both on their own and by exploring and tweaking pre-planned scenarios written by NBC News political experts Steve Kornacki and Chuck Todd. More than 2.4 million readers visited the page more than 5 million times. On election week, more than 1 million visited the page to get the latest results and to see what paths to victory remained for each candidate. Readers were able to share their own custom version of the map with friends, as well as the NBC News personalities’ picks.
2021-s-0340.tools: Personalisation, D3.js, Google Sheets, CSV, Node.js
2021-s-0340.authors: Anna Brand, Joe Murphy, Robin Muccari, Kara Haupt, Nigel Chiwaya, Jeremia Kimelman, Ellie Frymire
2021-s-0340.summaryJa: "道路-270"プロジェクトは,2020年の大統領選挙の進行をリアルタイムで説明するのに役立つ,独自のインタラクティブな選挙人大学地図ツールです.
2021-s-0340.impactJa: 道路 270 は,読者自身で,そしてNBCニュース政治専門家スティーブ・コーナッチとチャック・トッドによって書かれた,事前に計画されたシナリオを調査し,修正することで,選挙コレッジの投票組合せの可能性の変異を理解できるようにしました.2400万人以上の読者は5,000万人以上ページを訪問しました.選挙週,100万人以上が最新の結果を得るためにページを訪問し,各候補者の勝利への道は残っているかを確認しました. 読者は友人と独自のカスタム版の地図を共有し,NBCニュースの人格選定も行いました.

2021-s-0341.summary:
Satelite data shed light on deep underground

A section of road collapsed suddenly in a quiet residential area of Tokyo. By analyzing satellite Interferometric SAR data, Nikkei found that the ground level around the sinkhole warped soon after deep underground construction work took place. The cave-in happened following these movements in the surface. In Japan, companies can develop the “deep underground” space without the consent of landowners above. This is the first time that detailed data have indicated that deep underground construction may affect residents’ daily lives. The day after Nikkei’s report, the highway operator acknowledged impact of the construction.
2021-s-0341.impact:
Impact on Japan's infrastructure

Residents protested and demanded explanations from the highway operator. The Outer Ring Road that related to the incident is a highway designed to cut traffic congestion in the metropolitan area, but construction is halted because of the accident. No one knows when the construction will be completed. The maglev bullet train project, which will connect Tokyo and Osaka, has been forced to review its safety measures because it too plans to use deep underground space.

Blind spots in the law revealed

On December 21, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism said, "It is regrettable that the shield tunnel construction has caused damage to residents." In Japan, in 2001 it became possible to develop "deep underground," which is deeper than 40 meters, without the consent of the landowners. The goal was to effectively use underground space. However, the impact on the earth’s surface became apparent for the first time in 20 years, forcing Japanese society to rethink the safety of this measure.

Compensation may grow

After the news broke, the highway operator acknowledged the impact of the accident, apologized, and announced a policy of compensation for residents. Before construction it had said "the ground surface will not be affected." The company, which did not have Interferometric SAR data, announced that it had confirmed a pinpoint subsidence using a ground survey after Nikkei’s report. Nikkei’s analysis confirmed a wider range of depressions existed in the area, ranging from directly above the tunnel site to the other side of a nearby river. The highway operator had not been able to find the ground swellings that Nikkei showed. Members of the panel of experts investigating the accident have called for new investigations using Interferometric SAR, which may grow the compensation beyond the highway operator’s assumptions.
2021-s-0341.tools: Animation, Sensor, D3.js, QGIS, Canvas, CSV, Python, Node.js
2021-s-0341.authors: Nobutaka Hiramoto, Jun Yamazaki, Konori Fujita, Takeshi Yamada, Hiroshi Sagimori, Kaoru Yamada, Chihiro Uchiyama, Kenichiro Kamata, Hiroshi Kunou, Shohei Yasuda, Masayuki Shimizu, Gaku Ito
2021-s-0341.summaryJa: 衛星データにより,深地地下に光を当てた.東京の静かな住宅区で道路の一段が突然崩壊した.衛星インターフェロメトリック・SARデータを分析することで,ニッケイは深地地下建設が始まってすぐ後に地下洞窟の周囲の地面レベルが歪んだことがわかった.この洞窟は表面上の動きに続いて起こった.日本では,企業が上記の土地所有者の同意なしに深地地下空間を開発することができます. 詳細なデータから明らかになったのは初めてです. 地下建設が住民の日常生活に影響を与える可能性がある.ニケイの報告の翌日,高速道路事業者は建設の影響を認めました.
2021-s-0341.impactJa:
日本のインフラへの影響

住民は抗議し,高速道路事業者から説明を要求した.この事故に関連する外環路は,都市圏の交通渋滞を削減するために設計された高速道路だが,事故により建設が停止された.建設がいつ完了するか誰も知らない. 東京と大阪を繋ぐ"マグレフ・弾丸列車"プロジェクトも地下深層空間を利用する計画があるため安全対策を再検討するようになりました土地,インフラ,交通及び観光大臣は12月21日に"シールドトンネル建設が住民に損害を与えたことは残念だ"と述べた.日本では,2001年に土地所有者の同意なしに40メートル以上の深さの"地下地下"を開発することが可能になった. しかし,この事故の影響は20年ぶりに明らかになり,日本の社会がこの措置の安全性を再考するようになった. 建設前に"地面表面は影響を受けない"と宣言した.Interferometric SARデータを持たない会社は,ニッケイの報告の後,地調査を使用して定点沈没を確認したことを発表した.ニッケイの分析により,トンネル現場から近くの川の向こう側まで,この地域でより広い範囲の沈没が存在していることを確認した.高速道路運営者はニッケイが示した地面膨張を検出できなかった. 事故を調査する専門家パネルのメンバーは,インターフェロメトリック SARを用いて新たな調査を要請し,この措置により,自動車道事業者の仮定を超えて補償額が拡大する可能性がある.

2021-s-0342.summary: In 2019, despite fewer total crossings, the Central Mediterranean route was deadlier than any of the previous four years: more than one in 20 people migrating from Northern Africa to Europe on this route died at sea. Combining graphics, sonifications and analysis, our project presented this data in the context of efforts from different governments to stop Search and Rescue (SAR) missions in the area. By reconstructing different vessels' historical operations, we could show that political decisions led to a decrease in NGO-run SAR vessel presence. We put the increased death rate into a context no data existed in before.
2021-s-0342.impact: As a student project, it did not have a large reach or impact. However, we received feedback that it had inspired fellow students to use simple tools in ways they had not thought of before, especially in increasing the accessibility of data visualisations for blind consumers. As offered in the Sigma Award Rules, we would like to be considered for a "Young Talent" prize (but couldn't find a designated field to indicate it in this online form)
2021-s-0342.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2021-s-0342.authors: Áine Kelly-Costello, Ariadna Carrascosa Hidalgo and Ida Flik
2021-s-0342.summaryJa: 2019年,合計の越し数が少ないにもかかわらず,中央地中海路線は過去4年間でどれよりも致命的でした.この路線で北アフリカからヨーロッパへ移住する20人に1人が海で死亡しました.グラフィック,音響化,分析を組み合わせて,私たちのプロジェクトは,この地域における捜索救助 (SAR) 任務を止めるためのさまざまな政府の取り組みの背景にこれらのデータを提示しました. 異なる船舶の歴史上の運用を再構築することで,我々は,NGOが運営するSAR船の存在が減少することを政治決定がもたらしたことを示し,以前にはデータがなかった状況に死亡率の増加を置いた.
2021-s-0342.impactJa: 学生プロジェクトとして,広範囲に及ぶ影響もありませんでした.しかし,同学たちが以前考えていなかったようなシンプルなツールを使用するよう,特に盲目の消費者のデータビジュアライゼーションのアクセシビリティを高めるために,刺激を受けたというフィードバックが来ました.シグマ賞のルールでは,私たちは"Young Talent"賞に考慮されることを望みます (しかし,このオンラインフォームで示す指定されたフィールドが見つかりませんでした)

2021-s-0343.summary: Selling Our Genes is an investigative collaboration taht u into private sector access of public sector researchers and patient DNA by two national Irish media outlets - the Irish community-led crowdfunded platform, Noteworthy.ie, and Sunday newspaper, the Business Post. Concerns had been raised by patient groups about issues with consent and data ownership, in particular in relation to one study that intended to collect genetic data on over 9,000 brain tumour patients without consent. Our project was the first to delve into the controversial public-private partnership, reveal the extent of the connections and highlight concerns by patients, researchers and policy
2021-s-0343.impact: The investigation showed the extent to which a private company has developed a network of arrangments that give it access to a vast amount of publicly-held genomic data in Ireland, which is in turn used for commercial gain. By trawling through publicly available information and submitting numerous freedom of information (FOI) and press requests, the investigation revealed that Genuity Science, the main company involved in DNA sequencing in Ireland, has at least 25 links to facilities around Ireland. These include funding and collaborations with major hospitals, universities, research facilities and charities. The state took action against the company's plans to harvet genomic data from 9,000 patients by increasing the scope for patients (and their families) to opt out of this research. The investigation also highlighted policy gaps such as the lack of Government policy and adequate regulation resulting in private companies having no limit on how long they have exclusive access to the data they collect from Irish patients. The findings of SELLING OUR GENES were discussed by influential politicians, researchers and patients groups following publication. For example, the leader of one of the main Government opposition parties, the Social Democrats, said that SELLING OUR GENES was “a really important piece of in-depth journalism about how a private sector company got access to vast amounts of our DNA”.
2021-s-0343.tools: Animation, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, OpenStreetMap
2021-s-0343.authors: Maria Delaney, Barry J Whyte, Killian Woods
2021-s-0343.summaryJa: ゲノムを販売する (Selling Our Genes) は,アイルランド国内の2つのメディア (アイルランドコミュニティ主導のクラウドファンディングプラットフォーム,Noteworthy.ie) と,日曜新聞,Business Post) が公営部門の研究者および患者のDNAへのアクセスに関する調査協力です. 患者グループが同意とデータ所有に関する問題について懸念を提起した.特に1つの研究で,同意なしに9,000人以上の脳腫瘍患者の遺伝データを収集することを目的とした.我々のプロジェクトは,論争の的となる公私パートナーシップを深く研究し,その関連性の範囲を明らかにし,患者,研究者や政策の懸念を強調した最初のプロジェクトでした.
2021-s-0343.impactJa: 調査は,民間企業がアイルランドで大量に公開されているゲノムデータを利用できる,商業的な利益のために利用できる,ネットワークの構築をいかに深めたかを明らかにした. 公に利用可能な情報を探索し,多数の情報自由 (FOI) と報道要請を提出することで,調査はアイルランドにおけるDNAシーケンシングを主要に扱うGenuity Scienceがアイルランド周辺の施設と少なくとも25のリンクを有していることを明らかにした. 州は,この研究から離脱する患者 (およびその家族) の機会を拡大することによって,9,000人の患者のゲノムデータを収集する会社の計画に対して措置を取った.調査はまた,政府の政策と適切な規制の欠如などの政策のギャップを強調し,民間企業がアイルランド患者から収集したデータへの独占的なアクセスをどれくらい期間制限できないことを引き起こす. 出版後,影響力のある政治家や研究者や患者グループが,SELLING OUR GENSの発見について議論しました.例えば,政府の主要な反対党の一つである社会民主党の指導者によると,SELLING OUR GENSは,民間部門の企業が膨大な量のDNAにアクセスできた方法について,非常に重要なジャーナリズムだった.

2021-s-0344.summary: In an unprecedented, data-driven analysis of some 1,000 U.S. court decisions, Reuters revealed how a legal doctrine called qualified immunity insulates police from having to compensate victims of brutality. A 50-year-old creation of the Supreme Court, the legal defense is meant to protect government employees from frivolous litigation, but Reuters found it shields cops even when judges think they used force that could be considered excessive. The Reuters analysis of some 1,000 court decisions also found that the doctrine is applied unevenly, depending on where the victims live and that the obstacles to justice are especially pronounced for Black citizens.
2021-s-0344.impact: The series had political and legal impact in the months after it published as the United States grappled with widespread protest over police tactics. U.S. Reps. Ayanna Pressley and Justin Amash introduced the “Ending Qualified Immunity Act” in June. In a press release announcing the new bill, Pressley cited our findings. Our work was cited in the first congressional hearing that examined racial injustice and police brutality following George Floyd’s death. Sherillyn Ifill, president and director-counsel of the NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund highlighted Reuters’ investigative findings in written testimony. Our findings have been cited in multiple petitions at the Supreme Court, a Supreme Court amicus brief, an appeal before the 10th circuit, three university law journals, and a legal textbook. Our work also was cited by dozens of news organizations in the U.S. and elsewhere, including the Australian Associated Press, BBC News, and France’s Le Monde. The New York Times newsroom, opinion page and Editorial Board all separately highlighted our findings. John Oliver referenced the series in a segment about police reform. SCOTUSBlog, a well-read site that probes the inner workings of the Supreme Court, profiled our reporters and their work. LINK And the Washington Post interviewed one of our reporters for a video explainer about qualified immunity.
2021-s-0344.authors: Andrew Chung, Lawrence Hurley, Andrea Januta, Jaimi Dowdell, Jackie Botts and team
2021-s-0344.summaryJa: レイターズは,米国裁判所の1,000件もの判決を前例のないデータに基づく分析で,資格の免疫と呼ばれる法的教義が警察を暴行被害者に賠償を支払う必要がないことを隔離する方法を明らかにした.最高裁の50年にわたる法律防衛は,政府職員を軽い訴訟から守る目的で作られた.しかしロイターによると,裁判官は彼らが過剰な武力を使用したと考える場合でも警察を保護している. レイターズの1,000件の裁判所判決の分析によると被害者が住んでいる場所によって異なった方法でこの教義が適用され黒人市民にとって司法への障害は特に顕著であることがわかりました
2021-s-0344.impactJa: シリーズは,警察の戦術に対する広範な抗議を米国が抱えていたため,公表後数カ月で政治的および法的影響があった.米国代表者エイナ・プレスリーとジャスティン・アマッシュは6月に"資格の免疫を終える法"を導入した.新しい法案を発表する報道発表の中で,プレスリーは我々の発見を引用した.ジョージ・フロイドの死後に人種的不正義と警察暴力を調査した最初の議会の聴聞会で,私たちの研究は引用された. 法律防衛と教育基金の社長兼取締役弁護士のシェリリン・イフィルは,ロイターに<unk>調査結果を書面証言で強調した.我々の調査結果は最高裁の複数の請願書,最高裁判所の友書簡,第10回巡回裁判所の上訴,大学法学誌3冊,法律教科書でも引用された.また,米国の数十の報道機関も我々の研究を引用した. ニューヨーカー・タイムズ・ニュースルーム,オピニオン・ページ,編集委員会など,他の場所で,オーストラリア・アソシエテッド・プレス,BBC・ニュース,フランス・ル・モンドなど,我々の発見を別々に強調した.ジョン・オリバーは警察改革に関するセグメントでこのシリーズを引用した.最高裁判所の内部を調査する有名なサイトであるSCOTUSBlogは,我々の記者とその活動をプロフィールした. ワシントン・ポスト紙は資格のある免責に関するビデオ説明のためにジャーナリストの1人をインタビューしました

2021-s-0345.summary: Reuters visualised smoke released into the atmosphere during the fires across California in late summer. The smoke contains a substantial portion of fine particulate matter known by the particles’ size as PM2.5, which can have a major impact on people’s health. The animation built from millions of data points clearly showed the smoke travelled thousands of miles east, turning skies from New York to Washington D.C. hazy and reaching as far as the skies above Britain.
2021-s-0345.impact: It was shared widely on social media and received high readership traffic. It also showed the extent of how far the fires affected the world. Readers assumed the problem was restricted to far flung California, but in reality, the impact of the fire was affecting countries on different continents.
2021-s-0345.tools: Animation, D3.js, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite
2021-s-0345.authors: Marco Hernandez, Manas Sharma, Simon Scarr, Katy Daigle
2021-s-0345.summaryJa: ロイターズは夏の終わりにカリフォルニア州で火災が発生した時に大気中に放出された煙を視覚化した.その煙には PM2.5という微粒子の大きさによって知られている微粒子の物質が相当多く含まれている.この煙は人々の健康に大きな影響を与えることができる.何百万人ものデータポイントから作られたアニメーションは,煙が東に数千マイル移動し,ニューヨークからワシントンDCまで霧を覆い,イギリスの上空まで到達したことが明らかに示された.
2021-s-0345.impactJa: 広範囲にわたってソーシャルメディアで共有され,読者のトラフィックが高くなりました.また,火災が世界に影響を与えた程度を示しました.読者は,この問題は遠くのカリフォルニアに限ると仮定しましたが,実際には,火災の影響は異なる大陸の国々に影響を与えていました.

2021-s-0346.summary: Even though Taiwan has fared better in containing the COVID-19 pandemic than much of the rest of the world, shop owners around the island have suffered from a sharp shortfall of tourists and a fluctuating level of consumer confidence. For this project, we gathered some 20,000 listings over two years on rent.591.com.tw, one of Taiwan’s top online real estate agencies, to study changes in the shopfront rental market in the country’s six major municipalities.
2021-s-0346.impact: Beginning in March 2020, one could easily detect an increase in the number of “To Let” signs in the streets of Taipei, Taiwan’s capital. We sought to verify what we saw by using concrete figures and expanded our outlook toward other five major cities around the island. Our goal was to help readers get a comprehensive view of the climate in which Taiwan’s shopfront rental market found itself and feel the impact of the pandemic on Taiwan’s economy.
2021-s-0346.tools: Scraping, D3.js, JQuery, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2021-s-0346.authors: Lee Yi-ying, Sung Yu-tai, Lin Chi, Chen Ying-yu, Huang Shu-fang
2021-s-0346.summaryJa: 台湾は世界の多くの地域よりもCOVID-19の流行を抑制する上でうまくいっているにもかかわらず,島中の店主たちは観光客の急激な不足と消費者の信頼の変動に苦しんでいます.このプロジェクトのために,私たちは台湾のトップオンライン不動産代理店の一つであるrent.591.com.twで2年間で約20,000件のリストを集め,国の6つの主要自治体における店面賃貸市場の変化を研究しました.
2021-s-0346.impactJa: 2020年3月以降,台湾首都台北の街道で"To Let<unk>"の増幅が容易に検出され,具体的な数字を使って確認し,島周辺の他の5つの主要都市への見通しを拡大しました.私たちの目標は,読者が台灣の店面賃貸市場の環境を全面的に把握し,大流行が台灣経済に及ぼす影響を感じられるようにすることでした.

2021-s-0347.summary: Simple Search is a browser extension that highlights “traditional” or “ten blue links” search results. It opens a box that layers these results over the info boxes and other cruft that now eats most of the top of the Google results (and some other search engines’) pages. It works on Firefox and Chrome browsers, and for searches on Google and Bing. We built Simple Search after publishing an investigation in which we showed Google gave its own products 41 percent of the first results page and 63 percent of the first screen on an iPhone X.
2021-s-0347.impact: The Verge described the extension as, “a view of an older, simpler Google, one with surprising antitrust implications.” Simple Search has been downloaded nearly 2,500 times for Firefox and more than 7,000 times for Chrome, Google’s browser extension. As part of The Markup’s commitment to transparency, the extension’s code base is available on GitHub. There, readers have been able to identify issues, and one submitted a bug fix that was incorporated into an update to the extension. For a technology-focused publication that prides itself on its data-driven approach, this was an exciting form of reader engagement.
2021-s-0347.authors: Maddy Varner, Sam Morris, Evelyn Larrubia
2021-s-0347.summaryJa: シンプル検索は,検索結果を強調するブラウザ拡張機能です. 検索結果を情報ボックスや他のクロフトに重ねるボックスを開きます. 現在ではGoogle検索結果 (および他の検索エンジン) のトップページの大半を消費しています. Firefoxや Chrome ブラウザ,GoogleやBing で検索する場合は動作します. 検索結果の41%と iPhone Xの 63%のスクリーンを Googleが自分の製品に与えていたことを示した調査を公表した後 Simple Searchを構築しました
2021-s-0347.impactJa: Verge は,拡張を"より古い,よりシンプルなGoogleの視点"と説明し,驚異的な反モノロリティの影響を及ぼしている. シンプル検索は Firefox で約2,500回,Google のブラウザ拡張子 Chrome で7,000 度以上ダウンロードされている. 透明性へのコミットメントの一環として,拡張子コードベースは GitHub で利用できます. 拡張子への更新に組み込まれたバグ修正を提出しました.データ主導のアプローチを誇る技術に焦点を当てた出版社にとって,これは読者の関わりのエキサイティングな形態でした.

2021-s-0348.summary: The Australia bushfires razed more than 10.3 million hectares (103,000 sq km) of land - an area the size of South Korea. Reuters produced a novel storytelling graphic to depict and contextualize just how large this area actually is and give readers a true sense of scale for the fires.
2021-s-0348.impact: Nearly every Australian summer, the country’s landscape is engulfed in bushfires. But the scale of how big these fires are rarely truly shown. Coverage can sometimes be skewed towards California’s perennial problem, which receives a lot of attention. We were able to bring the issue to mainstream attention and show, purely based on size, Australia’s problem dwarfs that of California’s. This project was shared widely on social media and received high readership on Reuters platforms. The novel format of stacked scrolling squares has since been replicated by other news organisations covering fires.
2021-s-0348.authors: Manas Sharma, Simon Scarr, Marco Hernandez
2021-s-0348.summaryJa: オーストラリアの林火は,南韓国の面積の 103.000 平方キロで 1030 万ヘクタール以上の土地を荒らされました.ロイターは,この土地の面積を描き,その規模を文脈に収めて描き,読者たちに規模を確かめるために物語を語るグラフィックを作っていました.
2021-s-0348.impactJa: オーストラリアの夏にはほぼ毎年,この国の景観は森林火災に包まれています.しかし,これらの火災の規模はほとんど示されていません.カバーは時々カリフォルニアの長年にわたる問題に向け歪曲されることがあります.この問題は主流の注意を引くことができ,規模に基づいて,オーストラリアの問題はカリフォルニアの問題よりも矮小であることを示しました. このプロジェクトはソーシャルメディアで広く共有され,ロイタープラットフォームで読者の多くを集めました. 積み重ねられたスクロールスクエアの新型形式は,その後,火災を報道する他の報道機関によって複製されました.

2021-s-0349.summary: My report is about the impact of alcohol smuggling from South Africa to Mozambique across the Resano Garcia border, which is the main Mozambican trade border. The report presents numerical data and evidence on the subject while attempting to illustrate the different paths used by smugglers to deceive the authorities. all stakeholders have been called upon to address the issue in a comprehensive manner and with unique and relevant data.
2021-s-0349.impact: This report motivated more aggressive decisions by the national authorities which ended up undoing the structure of the main place for the sale of smuggled alcoholic drinks in Maputo which is the Estrela market which, for many years, everything that happens in the place was ignored by the authorities. There was also a greater tightening of the tax stamp on imported alcohol bottles, while the tax authorities saw some improvement in their conditions and means of combating smuggling, especially across the Ressano Garcia border.
2021-s-0349.summaryJa: 私のレポートは,モザンビークの主要貿易国境であるレサノ・ガルシア国境を越えて,南アフリカからモザンビークへのアルコール密輸の影響についてです.このレポートでは,密輸者が当局を欺くために利用するさまざまな経路を説明しようとしながら,この問題に関する数値データと証拠を提示しています.すべての関係者に対し,包括的な方法で,ユニークな関連データで問題を解決するよう求められています.
2021-s-0349.impactJa: この報告は,国内当局がより積極的な決定を促し,最終的にマプトの密輸アルコール飲料の販売の主要場所であるエステラ市場を壊した. 輸入アルコールボトルに対する税印の強化も増やされ,税務当局はレサノ・ガルシア国境を越えて特に密輸と戦う条件と手段の改善を観察した.

2021-s-0350.summary: Domestic violence is a big issue in Brazil: in 2020, one woman was killed each 9 hours. One of the public actions to fight it are the Women’s Specialized Police Stations, where women can seek specialized support to denounce violence and have access to protective measures. The project checked which are the Specialized Stations really working in Brazil, contacting each one of them, and created a map for women to have easy access to it. It led to the information that only 7% of cities in the country have at least one .
2021-s-0350.impact: The project had great repercussions in national media, being mentioned in more than 30 publications, in journalistic sites and television, leading to more awareness of the population about the real importance of the police stations and also about the problem of the lack of their implementation. About one month after the publication of the project, a Law Project was presented to the Congress by Congresswoman Elcione Barbalho requesting that women facing domestic violence can have support in the public defense in the cities where there are no Specialized Police Stations. And the map has been helping women access the help they need, when it is available. More than 2,5 thousand women used it on our website. And it is also available in the app Penhas, which helps women facing domestic violence and has around 5,5 thousand users. And the database, which is open and available for free online, have been used by other initiative that help women in Brazil, like Mapa do Acolhimento.
2021-s-0350.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2021-s-0350.authors: Helena Bertho, Gabi Coelho, Rayanne Moura, Thais Fôlego, Larissa Ribeiro, Carolina Herrera, Carolina Oms
2021-s-0350.summaryJa: 国内暴力はブラジルでは大きな問題です.2020年に1人の女性が1人ずつ殺害されました. 女性たちは暴力を非難し,保護措置にアクセスできる専門的な支援を求めた女性専門警察署です. ブラジルでは実際に活動している専門ステーションを調査し,各ステーションに連絡し,女性が簡単にアクセスできる地図を作成しました.
2021-s-0350.impactJa: このプロジェクトは30以上の出版物,新聞サイト,テレビで言及され,警察署の本当の重要性と,その実施の欠如の問題について市民の意識を高めました. 特別警察署がない都市で家庭内暴力に直面する女性たちが公共防衛の支援を受けられるよう要求する法律案が議会に提出された約1ヶ月後議会議員エルシエノ・バルボは,地図が女性たちに必要な支援を入手できるように支援してきました. またペナスアプリも利用できます家庭内暴力に直面する女性を支援し約5万5千人のユーザーを利用していますオンラインで無料で利用可能なデータベースは,ブラジル女性を支援する他のイニシアチブ,

2021-s-0351.summary: This story is about people who got into a difficult life situation and don't want to give up. They put all the forces to have full lives. Surgeries, periods of rehabilitation, depression and despair made them look for a completely different purpose of life in the new circumstances. Doing sports is their dedicated desire to overcome this tragic situation, so that's way they've chosen basketball as the most active sports. This is kind of a challenge to fate for those who come to the basketball court to fight and win.
2021-s-0351.impact: One of the most important purposes of photojournalism is to attract people’s attention to difficult subjects as for example sports for disabled people. The main idea of the project is to show healthy people and people with traumas that our body is just an outer shell which doesn’t mean anything to what we really are. It shouldn’t have any influence on the quality of life and impose restrictions on our lifestyle.
2021-s-0351.summaryJa: この物語は,困難な生活状況に陥った人々についてです.そして諦めたくないのです.彼らは完全な生活を送るためにすべての力を尽くしました.手術,リハビリ,うつ病,絶望の時期は,新しい状況の中で人生の全く別の目的を探せました.スポーツは,この悲劇的な状況を克服する彼らの専念の願望です.だから,彼らはバスケットボールを最も活発なスポーツとして選んだ. これはバスケットボール場へ戦うと勝つために来る人の運命に挑戦するものです
2021-s-0351.impactJa: フォトジャーナリズムの最も重要な目的の一つは,障害者向けスポーツなどの難しいテーマに人々の注意を喚起することです.このプロジェクトの主な目的は,健康な人々やトラウマを患っている人々に対し,私たちの体は私たちが本当に何であるかにとって何の意味もない外殻に過ぎないと示すことです.それは生活の質に何の影響も及ぼし,私たちの生活習慣に制限を課すべきではありません.

2021-s-0352.summary: In light of the COVID-19 pandemic, this interactive project accounts for more than 1,000 measures taken from December 2019 to May 2020 in seven major countries: China, the United States, South Korea, the United Kingdom, Italy, France, and Germany. The data covers several perspectives, such as the number of confirmed cases, anti-epidemic policies, and medical research. This project aims to show how different countries dealt with this "super virus," besides analyzing different countries' policies and implementation.
2021-s-0352.impact: The "Super Virus" organically combines in-depth news reporting with interactive multimedia visualization, thereby enhancing communities' understanding of the novel coronavirus and the measures they should take to protect themselves and their fellows. This social impact can be gauged by the popularity of the project: At the time of making this report, its total views had reached 12.02 million, with 8.92 million unique user visits and 487,000 comments and reposts.
2021-s-0352.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2021-s-0352.authors: Zeng Ziyi, Zhou Minxi, Pan Zhaoyi, John Goodrich, Li Shouen, Chen Ran, Zhou Rui, Hu Yiwei, Shi Tao, Huo Qiru (Intern), Duan Huiran (Intern), Li Yixiao, Bi Jiankun, Xu Jiye, Si Nan, Zhang Shilei, Fan Yun
2021-s-0352.summaryJa: COVID-19 流行を背景に,このインタラクティブプロジェクトでは 2019年12月から2020年5月までの7つの主要国で,中国,米国,韓国,英国,イタリア,フランス,ドイツで1,000以上の対策が実施されています.データには確認された症例数,防疫政策,医療研究などいくつかの視点が含まれています. このプロジェクトでは,さまざまな国の政策と実施を分析し,この"スーパーウイルス"にどのように対応したか示します.
2021-s-0352.impactJa: "スーパーウイルス"は,コロナウイルスと仲間を保護するためにコミュニティの理解を向上させ,インタラクティブなマルチメディアビジュアライゼーションと深層的なニュース報道を有機的に組み合わせています.この社会的影響は,プロジェクトの人気によって測定できます.このレポートを作成する時点で,その総ビュー数は12202万件に達し,8.9200万件のユニークなユーザー訪問と487,000件のコメントとリポストでした.

2021-s-0353.summary: W We asked all the municipalities in Finland about the five top IT programs they use, the companies who provided them and the cost. What we found was that even though several attempts and even money provided by the government to get the municipalities to cooperate around IT solutions very few did. We could prove that many of the municipalities bought the same solutions from the same companies thus they argued that they had too different needs to cooperate with each other. In our visualisation we concentrated on the bilingual municipalities.
2021-s-0353.impact: The results showed that the explanation that it is impossible for municipalities to co-invest in IT-solutions has more to do with will and politics than with different demands. We also showed that a lot of the municipalities did not fulfill the demands when it comes to accessibility and IT-security much because of lack of knowledge about what they should demand when they negotiate with IT providers. A lot of the times the municipalities were at the hand of the IT companies. The examples of the municipalities that did cooperate showed that much could be gained. The results have been referred to and were widely discussed within the media and the different municipality organisations.
2021-s-0353.authors: Malin Ekholm, Petter West, Linus Lång, Niklas Fagerström
2021-s-0353.summaryJa: フィンランドではすべての自治体に対し,彼らが利用するトップ5のITプログラム,それを提供した企業,費用について尋ねました.我々は,自治体がITソリューションに協力するようするために政府によって提供されたいくつかの試みや資金でさえも,非常に少ないことが分かった.我々は多くの自治体が同じ企業から同じソリューションを購入したことを証明することができ,したがって彼らは互いに協力するためにあまりにも異なるニーズがあると主張しました. 視覚化では双言語の町村に集中しました
2021-s-0353.impactJa: 結果は,ITソリューションに共同投資することが不可能であるという説明は,異なる要求よりも意志と政治に関係していることを示した.また,多くの自治体は,ITプロバイダーとの交渉時に何を要求すべきかについての知識が不足しているため,アクセス性とITセキュリティに関しての要求を満たしていないことを示した.多くの場合,自治体はIT企業の手元にあった. 協力した自治体の事例は,多くの成果がもたらされることができると示した. 結果はメディアや各自治体組織で広く言及され,議論された.

2021-s-0354.summary: An unprecedented five-month journalistic investigation showed how decades of denounces of sexual abuse in swimming in the United States and Brazil exposed traumas, omissions, poorly conducted investigations and even ended on suspicion of political lobbying. Public documents obtained by the transparency of the bodies were essential to understand and give weight to the reports.
2021-s-0354.impact: 1 - The State Attorney for Children and Teenagers of the State of Amazonas opened an investigation officially about the complaints against the swimming coach and president of the local Swimming Federation. 2 - The principal technician denounced in Brazil withdrew his candidacy for his re-election as president of the swimming federation for another four years. The series of reports was published 10 days before the vote and he was the only candidate. 3 - Show other victims what sexual abuse is and encourage them not to accept undue advances and report, as the interviewees did. 4 - Shed light on the matter, since the reports had a great repercussion and forced the authorities and even parents of athletes to debate the problem and stay alert.
2021-s-0354.tools: Animation, Drone, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
2021-s-0354.authors: José Brito, Allan Santos, Fernanda Antunes and Vital Neto
2021-s-0354.summaryJa: 報道機関が5カ月間行った前例のない調査で,米国とブラジルで泳いで性的虐待を非難してきた数十年がトラウマや省略,調査が不十分に行われ,政治ロビー活動疑惑を突き止めたことを示した.
2021-s-0354.impactJa: 1 - アマゾナ州児童少年司法省は,地元の水泳協会のコーチ・社長に対する苦情について公式に調査を開始した. 2 -ブラジルで告発された技術者の主任は,さらに4年間水泳協会の大統領として再選の候補を撤回した.この一連の報告は投票から10日前に公表され,唯一の候補となった. 3 - 性的虐待とは何かと被害者に示し, インタビューを受けた者と同じように過剰な提言を受け入れて報告しないよう促す. 4 - 報告が大きな影響をもたらし,当局やスポーツ選手の親でさえこの問題について議論し,警戒を強いられたため, その問題について光を当ててください.

2021-s-0355.summary: Swing States project was born as part of the Trumpland media special reports covering the USA elections. The goal was to show the swing states from a different angle and bring in the Covid-19 element. More and more people were showing interest in voting early either via email, in person or online. Because of that, most of the states had to adapt their regulations. The final result was a clean dataset and visualisations that were providing different insights to the users for them to reach a final conclusion or identify patterns.
2021-s-0355.impact: By analysing, cleaning and comparing data from several sources, we identify a pattern during the last three presidential elections. By comparing each state’s law, the number of early voters during past elections and the final results, we were able to identify that a lot of Americans had already voted two weeks before the Election date and who were more likely to vote early (democrats or republicans). The impact of the project was to provide, in real time, an update on the number of people who already voted, to which party and identify the number of eligible voters who could already participate in changing the overall picture. It was the first time where data regarding early voters could potentially be used to determine whether a state would turn blue or red. A week before the Election’s date, some swing states were already showing the americans’ preference and providing some first insights on how the voting process had to rapidly be adapted to a new situation instead of postponing the elections.
2021-s-0355.authors: Miquel Pellicer, Ferran Morales, Maria Crosas
2021-s-0355.summaryJa: スイング・ステートズプロジェクトは,米国選挙に関する特別の報道の一環として誕生した.その目的は,スイング・ステートズを異なる角度から示すこと,そして,COVID-19要素を導入することであった.メール,個人またはオンラインで早期投票に興味を示している人が増えた.そのため,ほとんどの州は規制を適応させなければならなかった. ユーザが最終的な結論に達したりパターンを見出すために異なる洞察を提供した清潔なデータセットとビジュアル化でした
2021-s-0355.impactJa: 複数の情報源からデータ分析,清掃,比較することで,我々は過去3回の大統領選挙のパターンを特定しました.各州の法律,先回の選挙で早投票者の数,最終的な結果を比較することで,多くのアメリカ人が選挙日より2週間前に投票し,早投票する傾向が高いことを特定することができました (民主党人または共和党人). プロジェクトの影響は,すでに投票した人の数,どの政党に投票した人の数,および全体的なイメージを変えるのにすでに参加できる有権者の数を特定するリアルタイム更新を提供することでした.これは,初期投票者に関するデータが,州が青か赤かになるかどうかを決定するために利用されることが初めてでした. 選挙日より1週間前に,いくつかのスイング州は既にアメリカ国民に好みを示し,選挙を延期する代わりに, 投票プロセスは新しい状況に迅速に適応する必要があるという最初の洞察を提供していました.

2021-s-0356.summary: As of April 2020, nearly half of Taiwan’s confirmed COVID-19 cases were concentrated in Taipei City and New Taipei City. In "Taipei Lockdown", Commonwealth Magazine collaborated with Professor Wen from National Taiwan University to analyze and model how the virus would spread through communities in Taipei City and New Taipei City. Given the high population density and high human and economic activity of these two northern Taiwanese metropolises, what different containment strategies would most effectively contain the virus to prevent large-scale community spread?
2021-s-0356.impact: Commonwealth Magazine published "Taipei Lockdown" as cases were still rising in Taiwan and serious containment measures were being planned by the Taiwanese government. Worried about a potential lockdown, residents of Taipei City and New Taipei City began stocking up on toilet paper and rubbing alcohol while looking to the government and the media for information and guidance. After Commonwealth Magazine published this report, many other news organizations also picked up this story, allowing various epidemiologists to discuss potential lockdown strategies. Our charts appeared on various websites and television news programs, and Professor Wen was also contacted by the Taiwanese government to advise on potential lockdown measures. Although a lockdown never came to fruition, "Taipei Lockdown" served an important role in the discourse and preparation of Taiwan's pandemic response.
2021-s-0356.tools: Animation, D3.js, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2021-s-0356.authors: Chen-Hua Chen, Daniel Kao, Yi-Wen Lin, Yu-Hsin Lee
2021-s-0356.summaryJa: 2020年4月時点で,台湾の確認されたCOVID-19症例の約半分は台北市と新台北市に集中していた. "台北ロックダウン"では,国立台灣大学の文教授とコモンウェルツ誌が協力して,台北市と新台北市のコミュニティを通じてウイルスがどのように広がるか分析しモデル化しました. この2つの台湾北部都市の人口密度と人力・経済活動が高くなるため,広範囲にわたるコミュニティの感染を防ぐために,どの異なる抑制戦略が最も効果的にウイルスを抑制できるのでしょうか?
2021-s-0356.impactJa: 台湾ではまだ症例が増加し,台湾政府が深刻な抑制措置を計画していたため,コモンウェルツ誌は"タイペイ・ロックダウン"を発表した.タイペイ市と新タイペイ市住民は,潜在的なロックダウンを懸念し,政府やメディアに情報と指導を求める間にトイレットペーパーを貯蔵し,アルコールを擦り始めた. コモンウェルツ誌がこのレポートを公開した後,多くの報道機関もこの記事を取り上げ,様々な流行病学者が潜在的なロックダウン戦略について議論することを許可しました.私たちのチャートは様々なウェブサイトやテレビニュース番組に掲載され,文教授も台湾政府から接触し,潜在的なロックダウン対策について助言を受けました. 閉鎖は決して実現しなかったが, "タイペイ・ロックダウンは"台湾の流行対策の議論と準備において重要な役割を果たした.

2021-s-0357.summary: The Taiwan Transitional Justice Commission established online database which has records and photographs of victims of political persecution during the White Terror Period. In order to figure out how the victims were oppressed and who the oppressors were,we analyze the data such as gender, years of birth, residence and the trial process. Moreover, we interview 4 people who were arrested, interrogated, charged, or imprisoned during the martial law period.They share their stories about the life in jail and afterward.
2021-s-0357.impact: 1949, the Kuomintang Party was defeated by the Communist Party of China and moved the central government to Taiwan. To consolidate its authoritarian rule, the government promulgated the Martial Law and a brutal repression ensued, with tens of thousands of intellectuals, social elites, and dissidents believed to have been secretly tried, jailed, or murdered. The Taiwan Transitional Justice Commission collected a large amount of data which revealed information about victims and those who took part in the persecutions and what they did. However, the online database is too complicated to use because most people don't even know the victims' name, so they have no clue to search for anything. Therefore, we analyzed all the data by different subsets, such as gender, charge, and other details about the victims. For example, according to the database, both Taiwanese and Mainlanders were political criminal, with Taiwanese accounting for 55% of cases and Mainlanders 45%. This feature tried to use data to make the history of White Terror Period more easier to learn and provide diverse research perspectives.

2021-s-0357.summaryJa: 台湾過渡司法委員会がオンラインデータベースを設置し,ホワイトテロ時代における政治的迫害の犠牲者の記録と写真を収めた.被害者がどのように抑圧されたのか,抑圧者とは何者なのかを把握するために,性別,出生年,居住地,裁判過程などのデータを分析します. さらに,戒厳令期間中に逮捕,尋問,起訴,または投獄された4人のインタビューを行いました. 彼らは刑務所での生活とその後の物語を語っています.
2021-s-0357.impactJa: 1949年,中国共産党が国民党を倒し,中央政府を台湾に移行した.独裁政権を固めるために,政府は戒厳令を宣言し,残酷な抑圧が続いた.数十万人の知識人,社会エリート,そして反対派が秘密裏に裁判,投獄,または殺害されたと信じられている. 台湾過渡司法委員会が大量にデータを収集し,被害者や迫害に参加した者,そして彼らが何をしたかについての情報を明らかにした.しかし,オンラインデータベースは使用にあまりにも複雑です.ほとんどの人が被害者の名前をさえ知らないため,何も検索する手がかりがありません.したがって,私たちはすべてのデータを性別,起訴,および被害者の他の詳細など,異なるサブセットによって分析しました. 例えば,データベースによると,台湾人と大陸住民は政治犯罪者であり,台湾人は55%と大陸住民は45%を占めている.この特徴は,ホワイトテロ時代の歴史を学ぶのに容易にし,多様な研究視点を提供するためにデータを利用しようと試みた.

2021-s-0358.summary: 'In this world, nothing is certain except death and taxes'. This witty quote from Benjamin Franklin shows that people can’t run away from the duty of paying taxes. But it might not be true as always. There are some taxpayers who fail in their duty. In other words, there are tens of thousands of delinquent taxpayers who owe more than \200,000,000 (about $180,000) in South Korea only. We, the KBS Data Journalism Team, focused on this issue gathering, analyzing, and visualizing data about delinquent taxpayers to show who they are and what is taking place in our neighborhood.
2021-s-0358.impact: A change started off just with an interactive map. Since the Data Journalism Team at KBS provided an interactive map showing ‘How Many Delinquent Taxpayers Are in My Neighborhood’ in January 2020, people could get to understand who delinquent taxpayers are. For instance, people just going to the map, immediately come to know there are about 800 delinquent taxpayers in Gangnam district, Seoul. After publishing the map, people began to pour their shocking experience of knowing that there are so many delinquent taxpayers in their community, even in their rich community. With the viral, more and more people visited the online map. Around 10 months, more than 2 million people had visited the interactive map. And then, one of the organizations surprised by the huge response from the map was the National Tax Service of Korea itself. In the first place, the Tax Service got no interest in the map provided by the Data Journalism Team at KBS. But the Tax Service soon noticed the potential of the map. The National Tax Service had acknowledged this kind of map would be helpful to slow the spread of delinquent taxpayers. So the Tax Service decided to introduce its own version of map delivering who delinquent taxpayers are and where delinquent taxpayers live. This could be a turning point because it is the National Tax Service that has all kinds of information about delinquent taxpayers. Technically, the Tax Service could make a more detailed map than a public broadcasting company. And the Tax Service also announced to update the map every year. So a trial of making a map showing delinquent taxpayers from KBS resulted in making a map from the authority itself. As a result, good taxpayers have come to know easily much better about neighbors who don’t pay taxes.

2021-s-0358.impactJa: 変化はインタラクティブな地図から始まった.KBSのデータジャーナリズムチームは2020年1月に私の近隣で欠税者の数がどれくらいあるかを示すインタラクティブな地図を提供したので,人々は欠税者の誰かを理解することができました.例えば,地図にちょうど行く人は,すぐにソウル川南区の800人の欠税者がいることを知ることができます. 地図を公開した後,人々は自分たちのコミュニティ,裕福なコミュニティでさえ,多くの欠税者があることを知ることで,衝撃的な経験を伝え始めました. ウイルスの流行により,オンライン地図を訪れた人はますます増え,約10ヶ月間に, 2百万人以上の人々がインタラクティブな地図を訪れました. そして,地図からの大きな反応に驚かれた組織の一つは,韓国税務局自身でした. 税務局は,KBSのデータジャーナリズムチームが提供した地図に興味を示さなかった.しかし,税務局はすぐにその地図の可能性を認識した.国家税務局は,この種の地図が欠税者の拡散を遅らせるのに役立つことを認めた.したがって,税務局は欠税者の身分と欠税者の住居場所を伝える独自の地図を導入することを決定した. 税務局は,公営放送会社よりも詳細な地図を作ることができる.税務局は毎年地図を更新することを発表した.KBSから欠税の納税者を示す地図を作る試みは,当局自体の地図を作成した. その結果,良い納税者は,納税しない隣人について簡単によく知ることができます.

2021-s-0359.summary: In Rio de Janeiro the press always reports that "occupants of a car shot" at a target and made victims - treated as "isolated case". For the first time these cases were tabulated throughout the year, a "social cleansing" standard was established, which takes place in areas that are being disputed by traffickers and militiamen. The story was told through a slaughter that took place on the west side of Rio, in a dispute between militia and trafficking, on a video. In 2 years there were 91 attacks, which left 128 dead and 115 injured.
2021-s-0359.impact: The story of the video was told through a massacre that took place in the west of Rio, in a dispute between militia and trafficking. At a bar party, 4 people were killed and 13 injured when people fired from a car. The target was a militiaman. We talked to a boy who was a regular at the place and who was shot but survived. It was the first time that these crimes were reported as serial cases, by the Fogo Cruzado platform, which accounted for shootings in Rio. The police were asked about the progress of the investigations of 91 attacks and did not respond to us. We asked the prosecutor if there is any specific investigation into this type of crime and they said no. Despite the example being from Rio, we found that this model of "slaughter under wheels" happens in several states of the country and that people know them with names like "ghost biker" and "silver car". It is a common tactic that criminals use this tactic to "clean an area" and "send messages" to residents: whoever does not obey, dies. Most of the mapped crimes occurred in the Baixada Fluminense, the region where Rio's death squads were born decades ago. And through the way the attack is carried out - car color / model and virulence - it is possible to know who attacked. As this is a subject of popular knowledge, but not accounted for by the authorities and unknown to the population who lives far from the peripheries, we chose to present the subject - dense and violent - in the form of a video explainer, to facilitate understanding, but without being too hard. And worked. The video went viral on the internet and the subject was popularized.

2021-s-0359.summaryJa: リオデジャネイロでは"自動車の住民が標的を撃ち,犠牲者を生み出した"と報道され, "孤立した事件"として扱われる.この事件が一年中初めて表記され,人身売買者と民兵が争っている地域で行われる"社会浄化"の基準が確立されました.この物語は,民兵と人口販の間の紛争でリオ西側で起きた虐殺を通じてビデオで語られました. 2年間で91件の攻撃があり 128人が死亡し 115人が負傷しました
2021-s-0359.impactJa: ビデオの物語は,リオ西部の民兵と人身売買の間の紛争で起きた虐殺を通じて語られた.バーパーティで,人々が車から撃ち殺され4人が死亡し13人が負傷した.標的は民兵だった.我々は,その場所で常駐していた少年と話をした.しかし撃ち殺されたが生き残った.この犯罪は,リオで銃撃事件を記録したFogo Cruzadoプラットフォームによってシリアル事件として初めて報告された. 警察は91件の事件の調査の進展について尋ねられ,私たちに返答しなかった.我々は検察官にこの犯罪の特定調査があるかどうか尋ねると,彼らはノーと言った.この例がリオ出身であるにもかかわらず,我々はこの"車輪下殺"のモデルは,国のいくつかの州で起こっていることを発見し,人々は"ゴーストバイク"や"銀車"などの名前で知っている. 犯罪者はこの戦術を"地域を清掃し",住民にメッセージを送る"という一般的な戦術である.従わない者は死ぬ.地図化された犯罪の大半は数十年前にリオの死の部隊が生まれた地域であるバイスダ・フルミネンスで起こった.攻撃が行われる方法 - 車色/モデルと毒性 - によって,誰が攻撃したかを知ることができる. 広範囲にわたる地域から遠く離れた地域に住む人々には知られていないが,この話題は広く知られていて, 分かりやすく理解できるように, ビデオ説明書として紹介した. しかし,あまり難しいことなく, ビデオはインターネットで流行し,話題が普及しました.

2021-s-0360.summary: 2020 has shown us that the top-down broadcast model of the communications ecosystem is broken. It is networked and we are failing to understand how existing communities online have been hijacked to become vectors for mis- and disinformation. Using the ‘great reset’ conspiracy theory as a case study, we looked at the extent to which online communities have been used to become spreaders of disinformation following a decentralized approach, providing evidence on why disinformation travels quicker.
2021-s-0360.impact: The piece had a meaningful impact on the debate around new approaches to fight online disinformation and the role of fact-checks. It was shared by high-profile journalists, disinformation experts and researchers in the field, and its findings were cited in related articles, including by the leading Brazilian news website TAB from UOL, with 100 million users per month and 7.5 billion page views per month. The reaction to the piece was overwhelmingly positive and stimulated conversations around the role of pre-bunks and debunks in fighting disinformation. In 2020 disinformation has become more pervasive than ever. The piece proposes an innovative approach to a crucial issue that has a large impact on our daily life. Using data to find evidence of the power imbalance between conspiracy theories and the fact checks, our piece highlighted how often disinformation and conspiracy theories like the Great Reset have substantial structural advantages in the way they travel compared to quality information: instead of following the top-down or linear model of the mainstream media and fact-checks, they are shared across networked, participatory, and alternative information ecosystems.

The Data Unit of El Diario de Hoy visited the Family Status Registries of four municipalities and requested information from three more. The municipalities investigated are among the 15 with the most cases: San Salvador, Soyapango, San Miguel, Santa Ana, Ilopango, San Marcos and Santa Tecla.

Until June 15, six city halls recorded more than 421 suspected COVID-19 deaths on their death certificates. But, according to official data, to that date there were 76 deaths from COVID-19.
2021-s-0361.impact:
The post had 11,860 page views and an average read time of 3 minutes and 56 seconds. After the publication, the Minister of Health declared that "in all countries there is an under-registration of deaths from COVID-19", and explained that when the person dies without having been tested, even if they have had symptoms, their death is not registered as caused by COVID-19. 
 Days later, the association of Mayors, Comures, denounced before the Legislative Assembly that in their municipalities there were more burials with the COVID-19 protocol than the number of cases and deaths from COVID-19 recognized by the central government.

2021-s-0362.summary: Brutal fires hit the Amazon during 2019. From that sad episode, we thought we had to give perspective to our audience and dimension the real loss of the biggest tropical forest on earth. What do we really lose when a "football-pitch of forest is lost every minute"? What is damaging the rainforest in each of the 9 countries that is spread across? Since our audience is based in LatAm, we believed that mission was crucial. The result was a two-part in-depth data-driven project on deforestation and degradation - its silent-killer cousin - and the specific human activities that are causing
2021-s-0362.impact: The audience response was fantastic. Engagement time was above average in both BBC Brasil and BBC Mundo, with pick readership times of 5 minutes. It sparked great discussion on Facebook and all the graphic and infographic material was widely shared across social media, especially on Instagran. A special mention for our infographic on "what can we find in an hectare of the Amazon", we did in collab with Jos Barlow y Alexander Lees. Also, most of the main Environmental and Climate organizations in Latin America – both NGOs and organizations linked to governments in some cases – praised and shared links to our story in their social media outlets. Some of them as a response of our seeding campaign, such as Greenpeace or WWF Colombia. The project had a special impact in Brazil. Our work was quoted in the country’s Regional Justice Courts and circulated among unions of public servers of the federal courts in Amazon states. It was also the basis for academic papers in discourse analysis of the Brazilian government’s policies regarding the Amazon and it was also cited in the book Modern Brazil: A Very Short Introduction, by King’s College London Professor and director of the Brazil Institute Anthony W. Pereira. In the education front, the project was used in school tests in the Brazilian public school system, for 7th year students: shorturl.at/kCU46 We were also asked by Brazil’s School of Data to explain our process of collecting and processing the data, as well as our insights about the projects. RAISG, the only monitoring organization of the Pan-Amazon and one of our sources, invited us to be in a debate about the new deforestation and degradation data released in 2020. We were the only media outlet invited to debate with the experts: https://youtu.be/XvpMaoMeDGU

2021-s-0363.summary: For decades, the Cook County courts have functioned as a government body that is inaccessible to the public. Everyone familiar with the system knew it was a mess because of sloppy and inconsistent record-keeping. But a group of newsrooms asked themselves what would happen if they could extract, clean and reorganize that data so it could be usable to the general public? That was the spark that launched an unprecedented journalistic collaboration we now call "The Circuit." Reporters used the data to spot troublesome trends from two veteran judges. They also created a visualization of 20 years of criminal charge
2021-s-0363.impact: For the first time, access to systemic data in the Cook County court system is now available to the public. Our project standardized a massive amount of information so that it could be used and analyzed by researchers and reporters. We visualized trends in criminal cases over nearly two decades and presented it in a way that made it useful for those inside and outside the legal profession. It made information that was hidden from the public available for all to see. While other agencies in Illinois have reports and data sets that showcase the events in the judicial system, the data from the clerk’s office provides the most complete picture of what goes on throughout every level of the court. Though the work has taken a great deal of time, there remains much more work to do going forward and the work of The Circuit will continue. In the coming months, a key component of The Circuit’s plans will be to engage other news partners, from large organizations and small, as well as community groups to continue analyzing data, working on stories and unraveling the mystery of the Cook County court system.

2021-s-0363.authors: Casey Toner, Bea Malsky, Jared Rutecki, Emily Hoerner, Forest Gregg, Trina Reynolds-Tyler, Jean Cochrane, Hannah Cushman Garland, Abby Blachman, Josh McGhee
2021-s-0363.summaryJa: キュック郡の裁判所は数十年もの間公衆にアクセスできない政府機関として機能してきました. この制度を熟知する誰もが,不注意で不一貫した記録管理のせいで混乱していたことを知っていた. しかし,ある新聞室が,そのデータを抽出し,清掃し,一般市民に利用できるように再編できたらどうなるのか,と疑問に思いました. ジャーナリストたちは退役裁判官の2人の問題を解くためにデータを利用しました 20年の刑事起訴の映像も作成しました
2021-s-0363.impactJa: クック郡裁判所のシステムデータへのアクセスが初めて公開されました. 私たちのプロジェクトは膨大な量の情報を標準化し,研究者やジャーナリストが利用し分析できるようにしました. 私たちは近20年間にわたる刑事訴訟の傾向を視覚化し,法律専門分野内外の人にとって有用な方法で提示しました. 公衆から隠された情報をすべての人に利用できるようにしました. イリノイ州では他の機関が司法制度における出来事を示す報告書やデータセットを持っているが,事務局のデータでは,裁判所各レベルで何が起きているのかについて最も完全なイメージを提供します.この作業はかなりの時間を要しましたが,今後も多くの作業が残っており,サーキットの作業は継続します. 未来数ヶ月間サーキットの計画の主な要素はニュースパートナーを集める組織やコミュニティーグループからデータを分析しストーリーを研究しクック郡法廷システムの謎を解き明かすことです

2021-s-0364.summary: The Chilean social outbreak in 2019, was a major political event. The City as Text project: Documents, classifies and displays a large number of graphic interventions (visual data) made by citizens in the face of imminent government censorship. The project is a georeferenced register during the hardest days of revolt. A virtual tour of 2.4 km made by hundreds of photographs and hosted on a website, allows people from all over the world to live the experience of walking through those streets as an echo of social demands. This material represents a free, innovative and unique ‘National Memory Data Archive’.
2021-s-0364.impact: Days after the website launch some impacts began to present visibility. Today, after four months online, we can establish that: - First, participate in a cultural and political movement to establish a counternarrative about the appropriation of the public space by citizens, in the context of a government trying to impose the discourse of internal war, and public enemies. The president himself said during a public speech on October 20<sup>th</sup>, 2019<sup> </sup>: “ We are at war against a powerful enemy ” referring directly to the Chilean people. - Another outcome was mainly in the international arena. Since the dictatorship, exile created a Chilean diaspora spread throughout the world. People who had discourses against the Chilean development model imposed during the dictatorship a continuous to this day had found refuge in other countries. One of the unexpected effects was to connect people of the Chilean diaspora with the streets of Santiago resonating with their long-standing social demands and the fight against human rights violations. - In the field of Journalism: Reinterpreting photography as geodata, going beyond the common perspectives of photojournalism and opening a medium to new uses and experiences in the Chilean media. In the same way, this Archive collects information that has contributed to generating Data Activism as an echo of social demands. Finally, it has allowed the development of an alternative Data Journalism to the traditionally dominant ones (Telecommunications) that have contributed new studies. This specific data from a particular moment of crisis in Chile, provides accurate information by merging the quantitative with images (qualitative) opening boundaries in Quantitatives Journalism. - Due to the use of the platform as a Memory Archive, many research, webinars and articles have been published not only in Chilean universities and media, but also internationally giving more visibility and support to the crisis.
2021-s-0364.tools: JQuery, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
2021-s-0364.summaryJa: 2019年のチリ社会爆破は,主要な政治出来事でした.テキストとして都市プロジェクト: 市民が迫る政府検閲に直面して多くのグラフィック介入 (視覚データ) を文書化,分類し,表示しています.このプロジェクトは,最困難な反乱の日々において地理的に参照されたレジスタです. オンラインで撮影された数百枚の写真で完成した2.4kmの仮想ツアーでは,世界中の人々が,これらの通りを歩く体験を社会的な要求のエコーとして生きることができます.この素材は,無料,革新的な,ユニークな"国家記憶データアーカイブ"を代表しています.
2021-s-0364.impactJa: ウェブサイトの開始後数日,いくつかの影響が目立つようになりました.今日,オンラインで4ヶ月経った後,私たちは確認することができます: - まず,市民による公共空間の占有に関する反言論を確立するための文化・政治的運動に参加し,政府が内戦の議論を押しつけようとしている状況の中で,市民による公共空間の占有について反言論を確立します. チェリ大統領は10月20日 (月) に公聴会で語った. <unk> 我々は強力な敵と戦っている. <unk> チリ国民を直接指す. - もう一つの結果は主に国際舞台でありました.独裁政権以来,亡命はチリ人の世界中に広がった亡命を創造しました. 独裁政権下でチリが継続的に課した発展モデルに反対する議論を続けている人々は,他の国々で避難を求めた. 予期せぬ影響の一つは,チリの移住者たちを,彼らの長年の社会的要求と人権侵害との闘いと共鳴するサンティアゴの街と結びつけることでした. - ジャーナリズム分野:写真を地データとして再解釈し,写真ジャーナリズムの共通の視点を超えて,チリメディアにおける新しい用途と体験への媒介を開く. 最後に,新しい研究に貢献した伝統的に支配的なデータジャーナリズム (通信) に代替的なデータジャーナリズムの開発を可能にした.チリにおける特定の危機の瞬間からのこの特定のデータは,定量ジャーナリズムにおける画像 (質量) の開拓境界を数量ジャーナリズムに融合することによって正確な情報を提供します. - プラットフォームをメモリアーカイブとして利用することでチリ大学やメディアだけでなく,国際的に多くの研究やウェブinarや記事が公開され,危機に対する知見と支援が拡大しました

2021-s-0365.summary: “The Color of Coronavirus: COVID-19 Deaths By Race and Ethnicity in the U.S.” is the APM Research Lab’s ongoing nationwide COVID-19 mortality monitoring project, with a focus on racially inequitable deaths. The project combines original data collection, demographic data analysis, visualization and compelling narrative.
2021-s-0365.impact:
Equipped equity champions with data to drive their work. Nearly 1 million pageviews through mid-November. Indirectly cited by Joe Biden in the first presidential debate. Directly cited in congressional testimony at least 3 times. Referenced in articles about Sen. (at the time) Kamala Harris as she announced legislation to combat racial disparities. Cited in more than 300 news and media stories by national and international media outlets including Forbes, CNN, NBC News, Vox, JAMA, Politico, Newsweek, Al Jazeera, the Washington Post, The Hill, The Guardian, the New York Times and numerous others.
Data sets requested by nearly 70 institutions of higher learning, medical doctors, health equity think-tanks, etc., including: UC Berkeley, Syracuse University, Los Angeles Economic Development Corporation, Duke University, Margolis Center for Health Policy, Rutgers University, National Women's Law Center, Johns Hopkins University, Texas Health Institute, Native Hawaiian and other Pacific Islander COVID-19 Resource Team & Asian American and Pacific Islander COVID-19 Policy and Research Team, and more.
